#!/usr/bin/python3 -IS
"""microduck-helper：Microduck Studio 的 root 小助手。舵机总线交接三个动词，手柄配对 / 忘掉两个，鸭子热点开关两个，
写进主程序 / 读标定两个，SSH 密码登录开关两个。

为什么要它：Studio 的舵机页要自己打开舵机总线 /dev/ttyS2，主程序 robotd 就得先停下，用完再交还。
停、起 robotd 要 root，Studio 不是 root。所以 sudoers 只放行这一个文件，它只认白名单里的动词，
参数逐个校验，状态自己去读，不信网页传来的。

方案：scratchpad console/handover-plan.md（v2 定稿）§2.2、§4.2；规矩照 studio-ops-plan.md §7。

动词（参数是 stdin 里的一个 JSON 对象，先一次读完）：
  bus-take       {"by": str, "allow_seated": bool}   Studio 接管总线（不卸力）
  bus-give-back  {"by": str, "soft": true}            软交还：Studio 已经在总线上全卸了，起 robotd（起来了 = 运动模式 control，
                                                      或者标定模式的实时快照 ready / moving / read_error / stop_unconfirmed / power_pending）
                 {"by": str, "marker": {...}}         不卸力交还：写交接标记，robotd 接手保持
  bus-abort      {"by": str}                          中止交接：立旗、KILL robotd，总线还给 Studio
  pad-pair       {"by": str, "mac": 可选, "timeout": 10–120（默认 60）}
                                                       跑官方 /usr/local/bin/robotctl pad pair --json
                                                       （/var/lib/robot/weird-ble 板上会先停 btd、重开蓝牙）
  pad-forget     {"by": str, "mac": str}             跑官方 /usr/local/bin/robotctl pad forget MAC
  wifi-hotspot-down {"by": str, "ssid": 可选}        先写 Studio 连接窗口（90 秒，netcheck 不插手），
                                                      再 nmcli connection down Microduck-Hotspot，最多等 10 秒
  wifi-hotspot-up   {"by": str}                       nmcli connection up Microduck-Hotspot，最多等 30 秒
  calib-read     {"by": 可选}                       只读当前标定文件，回解析后的内容和现在的模式；
                                                      不拿 helper.lock、不写任何东西
  calib-commit   {"by": str, "joints": [{"id", "direction"}, ... 15],
                 "imu": {"source": "bus"|"bno08x"|"lsm6dsv16x", "quat": [w,x,y,z]},
                 "dry_run": bool}                    把零位 / 方向 / IMU 方向写进 robotd 的
                                                      /etc/robot/feetech-ft5/hd1910-calibration.toml，重启主程序；
                                                      出厂镜像跑标定模式时，写完删掉 zzzz-zz-microduck-commissioning.conf
                                                      切回运动模式；等 mode=motion、phase=control 且读回逐项一致；
                                                      任何异常都先换回备份。dry_run 只回要写的 TOML
  ssh-status     {"by": 可选}                       只读：SSH 密码登录开没开、ssh 服务在不在跑、radxa 登记了几把钥匙；不写任何东西
  ssh-password   {"by": str, "on": true, "password": str}
                                                       用户自己定的密码设给 radxa（chpasswd，走 stdin），写
                                                      /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/05-microduck-ssh-password.conf 打开密码登录，
                                                      sshd -t、sshd -T 读回确认真打开了，再 reload ssh；哪一步不对就删掉这个文件退回去。
                                                      密码 8–64 个可见字符，不能是 microduck；**密码不进日志、不进结果**
                 {"by": str, "on": false}             删掉那个文件、reload ssh：回到只认钥匙（radxa 的密码不动，sudo 还用它）

输出：一行一个 JSON {"step","level","ms","msg","detail"}，最后一行 step="done"。
同一份结果写进 /run/microduck-helper/last-result.json（Studio 重启以后读它）。

退出码：0 成功；2 参数错；3 状态不允许；4 忙 / 中止；5 执行失败；6 交接没成、总线已拿回（Studio 接着保持）。

几个路径（都在内存盘 /run 里，断电就没了，这是故意的）：
  /run/microduck-helper/bus-held          旗。robotd 的 drop-in 写着 ConditionPathExists=! 它，旗在 robotd 就起不来
  /run/microduck-helper/abort             中止请求（bus-abort 写，正在跑的 bus-give-back 看到就停）
  /run/microduck-helper/last-result.json  最后一次的结果
  /run/microduck-helper/helper.lock       bus-take / bus-give-back / calib-commit 一次只跑一个（bus-abort 不拿，不能被挡住）
  /run/microduck-helper/wifi.lock         两个热点动词一次只跑一个（跟舵机总线的 helper.lock 分开）
  /run/microduck-handover/handover.json   交接标记（目录 0700，只有 root 读写；robotd 读完就删）
  管理锁 /run/microduck-service-management.lock 由临时单元 microduck-bus-hold 一直拿着，板上的 service.sh 拿不到就不动

环境变量 MICRODUCK_HELPER_DETACHED / _REQUEST / _REQUESTED_MS：只给 bus-give-back / calib-commit 自己用。第一次被调用时，
用 systemd-run 把自己放进一个独立的临时单元再跑一遍，这样 Studio 死了也不会把它砍在半路。这几个变量只决定
「不要再转一次」，以及中止请求和结果怎么对号，**不给任何权限**。sudo 默认 env_reset，调用方也传不进来。

BIN = {"systemctl": "/usr/bin/systemctl", "systemd-run": "/usr/bin/systemd-run", "fuser": "/usr/bin/fuser",
       "logger": "/usr/bin/logger", "flock": "/usr/bin/flock", "sleep": "/usr/bin/sleep",
       "nmcli": "/usr/bin/nmcli", "journalctl": "/usr/bin/journalctl",
       "chpasswd": "/usr/sbin/chpasswd", "sshd": "/usr/sbin/sshd"}
CHILD_ENV = {"PATH": "/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin", "LANG": "C.UTF-8", "SYSTEMD_PAGER": "", "SYSTEMD_COLORS": "0"}


class RpcError(Exception):
    pass


class Stop(Exception):
    """动词提前结束：带上退出码、结果、原因。"""

    def __init__(self, code, result, reason, detail=None):
        super().__init__(reason)
        self.code, self.result, self.reason, self.detail = code, result, reason, detail


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 对外的东西都走 Ctx：命令、文件系统根、时钟、robotd 的 IPC、stdout。测试换一个假的进来。
# 没有任何环境变量能改 root（sudo 下那是漏洞）。

class Ctx:
    def __init__(self, root="/", stdin=None, stdout=None, env=None, self_path=SELF_PATH):
        self.root = root
        self.stdin = stdin if stdin is not None else sys.stdin.buffer
        self.stdout = stdout if stdout is not None else sys.stdout.buffer
        self.env = dict(os.environ) if env is None else env
        self.self_path = self_path
        self.check_owner = root == "/"
        self.fs_log = []          # (路径, 权限)：测试拿它核对「打算用什么权限」（Windows 上 chmod 不全）

    # 路径
    def p(self, path):
        return path if self.root == "/" else os.path.join(self.root, path.lstrip("/"))

    # 时钟
    def now(self):
        return time.monotonic()

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        time.sleep(seconds)

    def pid(self):
        return os.getpid()

    # 命令：名字换成绝对路径，环境变量只给最小的一份
    def run(self, argv, input=None, timeout=15.0):
        exe = BIN.get(argv[0], argv[0])
        try:
            r = subprocess.run([exe] + list(argv[1:]), input=input, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout,
                               env=CHILD_ENV)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
            return 127, "", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        return r.returncode, r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), r.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def run_robotctl(self, argv, timeout):
        """跑官方 robotctl，并把「超时被杀」单独报出来（run 会把 TimeoutExpired 折成 127）。
        返回 (rc, stdout, stderr, timed_out)；超时时 rc=None。"""
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(list(argv), input=None, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, env=CHILD_ENV)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
            return None, _text(e.stdout), _text(e.stderr), True
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
            return 127, "", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", False
        return (r.returncode, r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
                r.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"), False)

    def relay(self, argv, data, on_line):
        """跑 argv，把 data 喂进 stdin，子进程的每一行交给 on_line。返回退出码。"""
        exe = BIN.get(argv[0], argv[0])
        try:
            proc = subprocess.Popen([exe] + list(argv[1:]), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=CHILD_ENV)
        except OSError as e:
            on_line(json.dumps({"step": "detach", "level": "error", "msg": f"systemd-run 起不来：{e}"}).encode() + b"\n")
            return 127
        try:
            proc.stdin.write(data)
            proc.stdin.close()
        except OSError:
            pass
        for line in proc.stdout:
            on_line(line)
        return proc.wait()

    # robotd 的 IPC：一行一个 JSON-RPC 2.0（格式照 studio/rpc.py）
    def rpc(self, method, params=None, timeout=1.0):
        import socket
        s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.settimeout(timeout)
        try:
            s.connect(self.p(SOCK))
            s.sendall((json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params or {}},
                                  separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode())
            buf = b""
            while b"\n" not in buf:
                chunk = s.recv(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    raise RpcError(f"{method}：主程序关了连接")
                buf += chunk
                if len(buf) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
                    raise RpcError(f"{method}：回包太长")
        except OSError as e:
            raise RpcError(f"{method}：{type(e).__name__}: {e}") from e
        finally:
            s.close()
        try:
            msg = json.loads(buf.split(b"\n", 1)[0])
        except ValueError as e:
            raise RpcError(f"{method}：回的不是 JSON") from e
        if not isinstance(msg, dict):
            raise RpcError(f"{method}：回的不是对象")
        if "error" in msg:
            raise RpcError(f"{method}：{msg.get('error')}")
        return msg.get("result")

    def startup_report(self, timeout=1.0):
        """robot.startupSubscribe 的第一行就是完整的启动报告；读完就断开。"""
        return self.rpc("robot.startupSubscribe", {}, timeout)

    def boot_id(self):
        try:
            with open(self.p(BOOT_ID), encoding="ascii") as f:
                return f.read().strip()
        except OSError:
            return ""

    # 锁
    def lock(self, path):
        import fcntl
        fd = os.open(self.p(path), os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0),
                     0o600)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except OSError:
            os.close(fd)
            return None
        return fd

    def unlock(self, handle):
        try:
            os.close(handle)
        except OSError:
            pass

    def fsync_dir(self, path):
        try:
            fd = os.open(self.p(path), os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
        except OSError:
            return
        try:
            os.fsync(fd)
        except OSError:
            pass
        finally:
            os.close(fd)

    def is_root(self):
        return hasattr(os, "geteuid") and os.geteuid() == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 文件：目录要是真目录（不是软链接），写入一律「同目录临时文件 + fsync + rename」

def ensure_dir(ctx, path, mode):
    full = ctx.p(path)
    parent = os.path.dirname(path.rstrip("/"))
    if parent and parent != "/" and not os.path.isdir(ctx.p(parent)):
        os.makedirs(ctx.p(parent), exist_ok=True)
    if not os.path.lexists(full):
        try:
            os.mkdir(full, mode)
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
    st = os.lstat(full)
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "error", f"{path} 不是目录（可能是软链接），不敢往里写")
    if ctx.check_owner and st.st_uid != 0:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "error", f"{path} 的属主不是 root，不敢往里写")
    try:
        os.chmod(full, mode)
    except OSError:
        pass
    ctx.fs_log.append((path, mode))


_tmp_seq = [0]


def write_atomic(ctx, path, data, mode, uid=None, gid=None):
    d = os.path.dirname(path)
    _tmp_seq[0] += 1
    tmp = f"{d}/.{os.path.basename(path)}.{ctx.pid()}.{_tmp_seq[0]}.tmp"
    flags = (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
             | getattr(os, "O_BINARY", 0))          # Windows 上 os.open 默认文本模式，会把 TOML 的换行写成 CRLF
    fd = os.open(ctx.p(tmp), flags, mode)
    try:
        view = memoryview(data)
        while view:
            n = os.write(fd, view)
            view = view[n:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    try:
        os.chmod(ctx.p(tmp), mode)
    except OSError:
        pass
    if uid is not None and hasattr(os, "chown") and ctx.check_owner:
        try:
            os.chown(ctx.p(tmp), uid, gid)
        except OSError:
            pass
    os.replace(ctx.p(tmp), ctx.p(path))
    ctx.fsync_dir(d)
    ctx.fs_log.append((path, mode))


def remove(ctx, path):
    try:
        os.unlink(ctx.p(path))
        return True
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return False


def exists(ctx, path):
    return os.path.lexists(ctx.p(path))


def read_json(ctx, path):
    try:
        with open(ctx.p(path), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            v = json.load(f)
        return v if isinstance(v, dict) else None
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None


def _text(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return v.decode("utf-8", "replace") if isinstance(v, bytes) else str(v)


def _stderr_lines(err):
    return [line.rstrip() for line in (err or "").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def append_oplog(ctx, row):
    try:
        ensure_dir(ctx, OPLOG_DIR, 0o755)
        flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
        fd = os.open(ctx.p(OPLOG), flags, 0o600)
        try:
            os.write(fd, (json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    except (OSError, Stop):
        pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 一次动词：进度、日志、结果

class Op:
    def __init__(self, ctx, verb):
        self.ctx, self.verb = ctx, verb
        self.t0 = ctx.now()
        self.by = None
        self.stdout_dead = False
        self.lines = []
        self.lock_handle = None
        self.service_lock_handle = None
        self.request_id = ctx.env.get(REQUEST_ENV) if ctx.env.get(DETACH_ENV) == "1" else None

    def ms(self):
        return int(round((self.ctx.now() - self.t0) * 1000))

    def write_out(self, raw):
        if self.stdout_dead:
            return
        try:
            self.ctx.stdout.write(raw)
            self.ctx.stdout.flush()
        except (OSError, ValueError):       # 对方关了管道（SIGPIPE 已忽略，这里拿到的是 EPIPE）
            self.stdout_dead = True

    def emit(self, step, level, msg, detail=None):
        row = {"step": step, "level": level, "ms": self.ms(), "msg": msg}
        if detail is not None:
            row["detail"] = detail
        self.lines.append(row)
        del self.lines[:-40]
        self.write_out((json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
        try:
            self.ctx.run(["logger", "-t", "microduck-helper", "--",
                          f"[{self.verb}] {step} {level}: {msg}"], timeout=3.0)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 —— journal 写不进去也接着做
            pass

    def finish(self, code, result, reason=None, detail=None, record=True):
        level = "info" if code == EXIT_OK else ("warn" if code in (EXIT_STATE, EXIT_BUSY, EXIT_RETAKE) else "error")
        done = {"exit": code, "result": result, **(detail or {})}
        if self.verb == "imu-recalibrate":
            done["reason"] = reason
        elif self.verb == "robotd-update" and reason is not None:
            done["reason"] = reason
        self.emit("done", level, reason or result, done)
        if record:                       # 探测用的坏动词（bus-nope）照样回 done，但不覆盖 last-result / oplog
            row = {"verb": self.verb, "version": VERSION, "result": result, "exit": code, "reason": reason,
                   "detail": detail, "by": self.by, "ms": self.ms(), "mono_ms": int(self.ctx.now() * 1000),
                   "boot_id": self.ctx.boot_id(), "request_id": self.request_id, "wall": time.time(),
                   "stdout_dead": self.stdout_dead, "steps": self.lines[-30:]}
            try:
                ensure_dir(self.ctx, HELPER_DIR, 0o755)
                write_atomic(self.ctx, LAST, (json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
            except (OSError, Stop):
                pass
            append_oplog(self.ctx, {k: row[k] for k in ("wall", "mono_ms", "boot_id", "verb", "by", "result", "exit",
                                                        "reason", "ms", "request_id")})
        self.release_lock()
        return code

    def take_lock(self, what="总线操作", path=None):
        ensure_dir(self.ctx, HELPER_DIR, 0o755)
        self.lock_handle = self.ctx.lock(path or LOCK)
        if self.lock_handle is None:
            raise Stop(EXIT_BUSY, "busy", f"小助手正在跑另一个{what}，等它跑完")

    def release_lock(self):
        if self.service_lock_handle is not None:
            self.ctx.unlock(self.service_lock_handle)
            self.service_lock_handle = None
        if self.lock_handle is not None:
            self.ctx.unlock(self.lock_handle)
            self.lock_handle = None

def show(op, unit, props):
    argv = ["systemctl", "show", unit]
    for prop in props:
        argv += ["-p", prop]
    _, out, _ = op.ctx.run(argv)
    d = {}
    for line in out.splitlines():
        k, sep, v = line.partition("=")
        if sep:
            d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    return d


def robotd_state(op):

def running(st):

def stopped(st):
    return st.get("ActiveState") in ("inactive", "failed")

def hold_active(op):

def hold_start(op):
    """起 microduck-bus-hold。返回 True = 起来了并且站住了。flock -n 拿不到锁会马上退出，所以隔两次查 active。"""
    rc, _, err = op.ctx.run(["systemd-run", f"--unit={HOLD_UNIT}", "--collect", "--quiet",
                             "--description=Microduck Studio holds the service-management lock while it owns the servo bus",
                             BIN["flock"], "-n", SERVICE_LOCK, BIN["sleep"], "infinity"])
    if rc != 0:
        op.emit("lock", "warn", "起管理锁单元失败", {"rc": rc, "stderr": err.strip()[:300]})
        return False
    for _ in range(2):
        op.ctx.sleep(HOLD_CONFIRM_GAP)
        if not hold_active(op):
            op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "stop", HOLD_UNIT])
            return False
    return True

def port_free(op):
    """fuser 的退出码：0 = 有进程开着，1 = 没人开。别的 = 查不了。"""
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["fuser", PORT])
    if rc == 1:
        return True, None
    if rc == 0:
        return False, (out + " " + err).strip()
    return None, f"fuser 退出码 {rc}：{(err or out).strip()[:200]}"


def stop_robotd(op, step="stop"):
    """停 robotd：--no-block，每 100 ms 查一次，10 秒后 KILL。KILL 之前旗必须已经立好（Restart=always 要靠它挡）。
    SIGTERM 和 KILL 都不写扭矩（fork robotd/src/main.rs:1218-1231、4185-4186）。"""
    st = robotd_state(op)
    if stopped(st):
        op.emit(step, "info", "主程序本来就没在跑", st)
        return True
    if not flag_present(op.ctx):
        flag_write(op, "停主程序之前补立旗")
    op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "stop", "--no-block", "robotd"])
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + STOP_WAIT
    while op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        op.ctx.sleep(POLL)
        st = robotd_state(op)
        if stopped(st):
            op.emit(step, "info", "主程序停下了（SIGTERM，不写扭矩）", st)
            return True
    op.emit(step, "warn", f"主程序 {STOP_WAIT:.0f} 秒没停下，KILL（KILL 也不写扭矩）", st)
    if not flag_present(op.ctx):
        flag_write(op, "KILL 之前补立旗")
    op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "kill", "-s", "KILL", "robotd"])
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + KILL_WAIT
    while op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        op.ctx.sleep(POLL)
        st = robotd_state(op)
        if stopped(st):
            op.emit(step, "info", "主程序 KILL 以后停了", st)
            return True
    op.emit(step, "error", "主程序 KILL 以后还没停", st)
    return False

def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def _is_num(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(float(v))


def _quat(q, what):
    if not isinstance(q, (list, tuple)) or len(q) != 4 or not all(_is_num(x) for x in q):
        raise CalibError(f"{what} 要是 [w, x, y, z] 四个有限数")
    return [float(x) for x in q]


def normalize_quat(q):
    """单位化；零向量、nan、inf 都拒。误差 1e-6 之内才算数（跟 robotd 一样）。"""
    v = _quat(q, "四元数")
    n = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in v))
    if not math.isfinite(n) or n <= 1e-12:
        raise CalibError("四元数是零向量，没法归一化")
    return [x / n for x in v]


def _num_text(v):
    return repr(float(v))


def _bool_text(v):
    return "true" if v else "false"


def build_calibration(current, joints, imu):
    """按现在文件里的 name / id，加这次的方向和 IMU 方向，组一份完整的标定。

    current：现在文件的字典（calibration-status 里的 calibration，或者 tomllib 读出来的）；
    joints：[{"id": int, "direction": 1|-1}, ... 15 个]；
    imu：{"source": "bus"|"bno08x"|"lsm6dsv16x", "quat": [w,x,y,z]}。
    """
    if not isinstance(current, dict):
        raise CalibError("主程序现在的标定文件不是一个对象")
    rows = current.get("joints")
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise CalibError("主程序现在的标定文件里没有 joints")
    by_name = {}
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(row.get("name"), str):
            raise CalibError("主程序现在的标定文件里有一行关节没有 name")
        name = row["name"]
        if name not in JOINT_ID:
            raise CalibError(f"主程序现在的标定文件里有不认识的关节：{name}")
        if name in by_name:
            raise CalibError(f"主程序现在的标定文件里 {name} 出现了两次")
        by_name[name] = row
    if set(by_name) != set(JOINT_ORDER):
        missing = [n for n in JOINT_ORDER if n not in by_name]
        raise CalibError("主程序现在的标定文件不是 15 颗官方关节" + (f"（少了 {', '.join(missing)}）" if missing else ""))

    if not isinstance(joints, list) or len(joints) != 15:
        raise CalibError("joints 要正好 15 个 {id, direction}")
    dirs = {}
    for row in joints:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or not _is_int(row.get("id")) or row.get("direction") not in (-1, 1):
            raise CalibError("joints 的每一行要是 {id: 整数, direction: 1 或 -1}")
        if row["id"] in dirs:
            raise CalibError(f"joints 里 id {row['id']} 出现了两次")
        dirs[row["id"]] = row["direction"]
    file_ids = {row.get("id") for row in by_name.values()}
    if set(dirs) != file_ids:
        raise CalibError(f"这次的 15 颗（{sorted(dirs)}）跟主程序文件里的（{sorted(file_ids, key=str)}）对不上")

    out_joints = []
    for name in JOINT_ORDER:
        src = by_name[name]
        jid = src.get("id")
        if not _is_int(jid):
            raise CalibError(f"{name} 的 id 不是整数")
        lo, hi = LIMITS_DEG[name]
        out_joints.append({
            "name": name, "id": jid, "zero_raw": 2048, "direction": dirs[jid], "calibrated": True,
            "min_rad": math.radians(lo), "max_rad": math.radians(hi),
        })

    out = {
        "motion_enabled": True,
        "imu_mount_verified": bool(current.get("imu_mount_verified", False)),
        "imu_mount_quat": DEFAULT_BUS_QUAT,
        "current_ma_per_count": float(current.get("current_ma_per_count") or 0.0),
        "units_verified": bool(current.get("units_verified", False)),
        "imu_mounts": {},
        "joints": out_joints,
    }
    raw_bus = current.get("imu_mount_quat")
    if raw_bus is not None:
        out["imu_mount_quat"] = _quat(raw_bus, "imu_mount_quat")
    if "imu_bus_protocol" in current:
        protocol = current["imu_bus_protocol"]
        if protocol not in ("feetech", "dxl2"):
            raise CalibError("imu_bus_protocol 只能是 feetech 或 dxl2（由主程序验证后写入）")
        out["imu_bus_protocol"] = protocol
    if "imu_bus_profile" in current:
        if current["imu_bus_profile"] not in ("legacy", "qinmo"):
            raise CalibError("imu_bus_profile 只能是 legacy 或 qinmo")
        out["imu_bus_profile"] = current["imu_bus_profile"]

    raw_mounts = current.get("imu_mounts")
    if isinstance(raw_mounts, dict):
        for kind in ("bno08x", "lsm6dsv16x"):
            mount = raw_mounts.get(kind)
            if mount is None:
                continue
            if not isinstance(mount, dict):
                raise CalibError(f"imu_mounts.{kind} 不是一个对象")
            out["imu_mounts"][kind] = {"quat": _quat(mount.get("quat"), f"imu_mounts.{kind}.quat"),
                                       "verified": bool(mount.get("verified", False))}

    if not isinstance(imu, dict):
        raise CalibError("imu 要是一个对象")
    source = imu.get("source")
    if source not in IMU_SOURCES:
        raise CalibError(f"imu.source 只能是 bus / bno08x / lsm6dsv16x，现在是 {source!r}")
    quat = normalize_quat(imu.get("quat"))
    if source == "bus":
        out["imu_mount_quat"], out["imu_mount_verified"] = quat, True
    else:
        out["imu_mounts"][source] = {"quat": quat, "verified": True}
    return out


def _raw_position(zero_raw, radians, direction):
    return float(zero_raw) + float(radians) * float(direction) * 4096.0 / TAU


def validate_calibration(cal, source=None):
    """照 fork robotd 的 Calibration::validate 一条一条查。不过就抛 CalibError，说清哪颗、哪条。"""
    if not isinstance(cal, dict):
        raise CalibError("标定不是一个对象")
    allowed = set(TOP_KEYS) | {"imu_mounts", "joints"}
    extra = sorted(set(cal) - allowed)
    if extra:
        raise CalibError(f"顶层有不认识的键：{extra}（robotd 会拒绝整个文件）")

    if not isinstance(cal.get("motion_enabled"), bool):
        raise CalibError("motion_enabled 要是 true / false")
    if not isinstance(cal.get("imu_mount_verified"), bool):
        raise CalibError("imu_mount_verified 要是 true / false")
    if "imu_bus_protocol" in cal and cal["imu_bus_protocol"] not in ("feetech", "dxl2"):
        raise CalibError("imu_bus_protocol 只能是 feetech 或 dxl2")
    if "imu_bus_profile" in cal and cal["imu_bus_profile"] not in ("legacy", "qinmo"):
        raise CalibError("imu_bus_profile 只能是 legacy 或 qinmo")
    if cal.get("imu_bus_profile") == "qinmo" and cal.get("imu_bus_protocol", "feetech") != "feetech":
        raise CalibError("Qinmo 只支持 Feetech")
    if not _is_num(cal.get("current_ma_per_count")):
        raise CalibError("current_ma_per_count 要是有限数")
    if not isinstance(cal.get("units_verified"), bool):
        raise CalibError("units_verified 要是 true / false")

    bus_q = _quat(cal.get("imu_mount_quat"), "imu_mount_quat")
    mounts = cal.get("imu_mounts")
    mounts = mounts if isinstance(mounts, dict) else {}
    if set(mounts) - {"bno08x", "lsm6dsv16x"}:
        raise CalibError(f"imu_mounts 里有不认识的来源：{sorted(set(mounts) - {'bno08x', 'lsm6dsv16x'})}")
    checked = [("总线小板", bus_q)]
    for kind in ("bno08x", "lsm6dsv16x"):
        mount = mounts.get(kind)
        if mount is None:
            continue
        if not isinstance(mount, dict):
            raise CalibError(f"imu_mounts.{kind} 不是一个对象")
        if not isinstance(mount.get("verified"), bool):
            raise CalibError(f"imu_mounts.{kind}.verified 要是 true / false")
        checked.append((CHIP_CN[kind], _quat(mount.get("quat"), f"imu_mounts.{kind}.quat")))
    for label, q in checked:
        norm = sum(x * x for x in q)
        if not math.isfinite(norm) or abs(norm - 1.0) > 1e-6:
            raise CalibError(f"{label} 的安装方向四元数不是单位长度（误差要 ≤ 1e-6，现在是 {norm - 1.0:+.2e}）")

    if cal.get("units_verified") and float(cal["current_ma_per_count"]) <= 0.0:
        raise CalibError("units_verified = true 时 current_ma_per_count 必须是正数")

    joints = cal.get("joints")
    if not isinstance(joints, list) or len(joints) != 15:
        raise CalibError("要正好 15 颗关节（官方顺序）")
    seen = set()
    for i, name in enumerate(JOINT_ORDER):
        j = joints[i]
        if not isinstance(j, dict):
            raise CalibError(f"{name}（第 {i + 1} 颗）不是一个对象")
        if j.get("name") != name:
            raise CalibError(f"第 {i + 1} 颗要是 {name}，现在是 {j.get('name')!r}（15 颗必须按官方顺序）")
        jid = j.get("id")
        if not _is_int(jid) or jid >= 254 or jid == 200:
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：id 要是小于 254 的整数、不能是 200（IMU 小板），现在是 {jid!r}")
        if jid in seen:
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：id {jid} 跟前面重复了")
        seen.add(jid)
        zero = j.get("zero_raw")
        if not _is_int(zero) or not 0 <= zero <= 4095:
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：zero_raw 要是 0–4095，现在是 {zero!r}")
        direction = j.get("direction")
        if direction not in (-1, 1):
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：direction 只能是 1 或 -1，现在是 {direction!r}")
        if not isinstance(j.get("calibrated"), bool):
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：calibrated 要是 true / false")
        lo, hi = j.get("min_rad"), j.get("max_rad")
        if lo is None and hi is None:
            if j.get("calibrated"):
                raise CalibError(f"{name}：标了 calibrated 就必须有限位")
            continue
        if not (_is_num(lo) and _is_num(hi)):
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：限位要两个都有、都是有限数")
        lo, hi = float(lo), float(hi)
        if not lo < hi:
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：min_rad 要小于 max_rad（{lo:g} / {hi:g}）")
        for edge, value in (("min", lo), ("max", hi)):
            raw = _raw_position(zero, value, direction)
            if not math.isfinite(raw) or not 0.0 <= round(raw) <= 4095.0:
                raise CalibError(f"{name}：{edge}_rad 换成的读数 {raw:.1f} 不在 0–4095（会跨过单圈边界）")
        home = HOME_RAD[name]
        if not lo <= home <= hi:
            raise CalibError(f"{name}：限位 {lo:.4f}–{hi:.4f} 没包住官方 HOME {home:.4f}")

    if cal.get("motion_enabled"):
        if any(not j.get("calibrated") or j.get("min_rad") is None or j.get("max_rad") is None for j in joints):
            raise CalibError("motion_enabled = true 时 15 颗都要 calibrated 且有限位")
        if source in ("bno08x", "lsm6dsv16x"):
            mount = mounts.get(source) or {}
            verified = bool(mount.get("verified")) if isinstance(mount, dict) else False
            label = CHIP_CN[source]
        elif source == "bus":
            verified, label = bool(cal.get("imu_mount_verified")), CHIP_CN["bus"]
        else:
            verified = bool(cal.get("imu_mount_verified")) or any(
                isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("verified") for m in mounts.values())
            label = "正在用的那颗"
        if not verified:
            raise CalibError(f"motion_enabled = true 时正在用的 {label} IMU 方向要 verified")
    return cal


def render_calibration(cal):
    """自己写 TOML：顶层键 → [imu_mounts.*] → [[joints]]。写完要再用 tomllib 读回来核对。"""
    lines = [
        f"motion_enabled = {_bool_text(cal.get('motion_enabled'))}",
        f"imu_mount_verified = {_bool_text(cal.get('imu_mount_verified'))}",
        "imu_mount_quat = [" + ", ".join(_num_text(x) for x in cal.get("imu_mount_quat") or []) + "]",
        f"current_ma_per_count = {_num_text(cal.get('current_ma_per_count') or 0.0)}",
        f"units_verified = {_bool_text(cal.get('units_verified'))}",
    ]
    if "imu_bus_protocol" in cal:
        if cal["imu_bus_protocol"] not in ("feetech", "dxl2"):
            raise CalibError("imu_bus_protocol 只能是 feetech 或 dxl2")
        lines.append(f'imu_bus_protocol = "{cal["imu_bus_protocol"]}"')
    if "imu_bus_profile" in cal:
        if cal["imu_bus_profile"] not in ("legacy", "qinmo"):
            raise CalibError("imu_bus_profile 只能是 legacy 或 qinmo")
        lines.append(f'imu_bus_profile = "{cal["imu_bus_profile"]}"')
    mounts = cal.get("imu_mounts") or {}
    for kind in ("bno08x", "lsm6dsv16x"):
        mount = mounts.get(kind)
        if mount is None:
            continue
        lines += ["", f"[imu_mounts.{kind}]",
                  "quat = [" + ", ".join(_num_text(x) for x in mount.get("quat") or []) + "]",
                  f"verified = {_bool_text(mount.get('verified'))}"]
    for j in cal.get("joints") or []:
        lines += ["", "[[joints]]",
                  f'name = "{j.get("name")}"',
                  f'id = {int(j.get("id"))}',
                  f'zero_raw = {int(j.get("zero_raw"))}',
                  f'direction = {int(j.get("direction"))}',
                  f'calibrated = {_bool_text(j.get("calibrated"))}']
        if j.get("min_rad") is not None:
            lines.append(f'min_rad = {_num_text(j.get("min_rad"))}')
        if j.get("max_rad") is not None:
            lines.append(f'max_rad = {_num_text(j.get("max_rad"))}')
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def normalized_calibration(cal):
    """读回来以后比对用：空的 [imu_mounts] 不写出来，读回来就没有这个键。"""
    out = dict(cal)
    out["imu_mounts"] = dict(cal.get("imu_mounts") or {})
    return out


def same_calibration(a, b):
    """逐项严格比：TOML 用 repr 写浮点，读回来一定一模一样。"""
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        return set(a) == set(b) and all(same_calibration(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list):
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(same_calibration(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    if isinstance(a, bool) or isinstance(b, bool):
        return a is b
    if isinstance(a, float) or isinstance(b, float):
        return isinstance(a, (int, float)) and isinstance(b, (int, float)) and float(a) == float(b)
    return a == b

JOINT_REQUIRED = ("id", "torque", "goal", "present", "offset")
JOINT_OPTIONAL = {"load": (-32767, 32767), "temp": (0, 255), "status": (0, 255)}


def build_marker(op, given, by):
    """校验 Studio 给的标记内容，填上 boot_id、mono_ms。ttl_ms 超过 30000 直接拒（不悄悄截断）。"""
    if not isinstance(given, dict):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", "marker 要是一个对象")
    check_keys(given, ("schema", "requested_by", "ttl_ms", "port", "arm_registers", "joints", "boot_id", "mono_ms"),
               "marker")
    if "schema" in given and given["schema"] != SCHEMA:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.schema 只认 {SCHEMA}")
    rb = given.get("requested_by", by)
    if not isinstance(rb, str) or not rb or len(rb) > 200:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", "marker.requested_by 要是 1–200 个字的字符串")
    ttl = given.get("ttl_ms", TTL_DEFAULT_MS)
    if not is_int(ttl) or not TTL_MIN_MS <= ttl <= TTL_MAX_MS:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.ttl_ms 要在 {TTL_MIN_MS}–{TTL_MAX_MS} 之间（robotd 最多认 30 秒）")
    port = given.get("port", PORT)
    if port != PORT:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.port 只能是 {PORT}")
    arm = given.get("arm_registers")
    if arm is not None:
        if not isinstance(arm, dict) or set(arm) != {"limit", "p", "d"} or not all(is_int(v) for v in arm.values()) \
                or not 0 <= arm["limit"] <= 65535 or not 0 <= arm["p"] <= 255 or not 0 <= arm["d"] <= 255:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", "marker.arm_registers 要是 {limit 0–65535, p 0–255, d 0–255}")
    joints = given.get("joints")
    if not isinstance(joints, list) or len(joints) != 15:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", "marker.joints 要正好 15 行")
    seen, rows = set(), []
    for j in joints:
        if not isinstance(j, dict):
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", "marker.joints 每一行要是对象")
        check_keys(j, JOINT_REQUIRED + tuple(JOINT_OPTIONAL), "marker.joints 的一行")
        for k in JOINT_REQUIRED:
            if not is_int(j.get(k)):
                raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints：{k} 要是整数（{j.get('id')}）")
        jid = j["id"]
        if jid not in JOINT_IDS or jid in seen:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints：id {jid} 不在 15 颗里，或者重复了")
        seen.add(jid)
        if j["torque"] != 1:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints：#{jid} 没上力（torque 要是 1）。主程序只接手 15 颗全开的")
        for k in ("goal", "present", "offset"):
            if not -32767 <= j[k] <= 32767:
                raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints：#{jid} 的 {k} 超出 −32767..32767")
        for k, (lo, hi) in JOINT_OPTIONAL.items():
            if k in j and (not is_int(j[k]) or not lo <= j[k] <= hi):
                raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints：#{jid} 的 {k} 要是 {lo}..{hi} 的整数")
        rows.append({k: j[k] for k in JOINT_REQUIRED + tuple(JOINT_OPTIONAL) if k in j})
    if seen != JOINT_IDS:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_marker", f"marker.joints 少了 {sorted(JOINT_IDS - seen)}")
    out = {"schema": SCHEMA, "requested_by": rb, "boot_id": op.ctx.boot_id(), "mono_ms": int(op.ctx.now() * 1000),
           "ttl_ms": ttl, "port": PORT, "joints": rows}
    if arm is not None:
        out["arm_registers"] = arm
    return out

def judge(bus, safe, pol, allow_seated):
    """一次读数的判决：("ok"|"seated"|"wait"|"refuse", 原因)。"""
    if not isinstance(bus, dict):
        return "refuse", "主程序回的 busStatus 不是对象"
    phase, mode = bus.get("phase"), bus.get("mode")
    if phase in STARTING_PHASES:
        return "ok", f"主程序还在启动阶段（{phase}），没发过目标"
    if mode == "commissioning":
        return "ok", "标定模式"
    if mode != "motion" or phase != "control":
        return "refuse", f"看不懂主程序现在的状态（mode={mode}，phase={phase}）"
    native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
    torque = native.get("torque_state_confirmed")
    sitting = isinstance(pol, dict) and pol.get("sitting") is True
    if bus.get("policy_enabled") is True:
        if sitting:
            if not allow_seated:
                return "refuse", "坐着（策略在做坐姿），这次没允许坐姿接管"
            if not (isinstance(safe, dict) and safe.get("safe") is True):
                return "refuse", "坐下或站起的动作还没做完（safeToRestart 不是 true）"
            return "seated", "坐着，坐姿动作已经做完"
        return "refuse", "策略在跑（站着、技能或身体姿态模式）：先按手柄 Start 或点「停下」，等它 2 秒平滑回站姿，再点接管"
    if bus.get("home_recovery") is True:
        return "refuse", "LB 起身还没结束"
    if isinstance(safe, dict) and safe.get("safe") is False:
        return "refuse", f"主程序说现在不能打断：{safe.get('reason')}"
    if torque is False:
        return "ok", "卸力着"
    if native.get("handover_hold") is True:
        return "ok", "主程序接手保持中"
    if torque is True:
        if bus.get("homed") is True:
            return "ok", "站姿保持（策略关着）"
        return "wait", "正在回站姿"
    return "refuse", "主程序没报扭矩状态（torque_state_confirmed 不知道）"


def joint_positions(bus):
    native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus, dict) and isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
    out = {}
    for j in native.get("joints") or []:
        if isinstance(j, dict) and isinstance(j.get("position_rad"), (int, float)) and not isinstance(j.get("position_rad"), bool):
            out[j.get("id")] = float(j["position_rad"])
    return out


def read_robotd(op):
    """busStatus（必须读到）、safeToRestart、policies（运动模式控制阶段才读）。"""
    bus = op.ctx.rpc("robot.busStatus", {}, 1.0)
    try:
        safe = op.ctx.rpc("robot.safeToRestart", {}, 1.0)
    except RpcError:
        safe = None
    pol = None
    if isinstance(bus, dict) and bus.get("mode") == "motion" and bus.get("phase") == "control":
        try:
            pol = op.ctx.rpc("robot.policies", {}, 1.0)
        except RpcError:
            pol = None
    return bus, safe, pol


def gate(op, allow_seated):
    """隔 200 ms 读两次，两次都满足才放行。正在回站姿最多等 3 秒。返回放行原因；不放行就抛 Stop(3)。"""
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + HOMING_WAIT
    while True:
        if stopped(robotd_state(op)):
            return "主程序没在跑"
        try:
            r1 = read_robotd(op)
            op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)
            r2 = read_robotd(op)
        except RpcError as e:
            if stopped(robotd_state(op)):
                return "主程序没在跑"
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"主程序在跑，但不回话：{e}。等几秒再试") from e
        v1, v2 = judge(*r1, allow_seated), judge(*r2, allow_seated)
        op.emit("gate", "info", "两次读主程序状态", {"first": v1, "second": v2})
        if v1[0] == "refuse" or v2[0] == "refuse":
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", (v2 if v2[0] == "refuse" else v1)[1])
        if v1[0] == v2[0] == "ok":
            return v2[1]
        if v1[0] == v2[0] == "seated":
            a, b = joint_positions(r1[0]), joint_positions(r2[0])
            if set(a) != set(b) or len(a) != 15:
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "坐着，但读不全 15 颗关节的位置，判不了动没动")
            moved = {jid: round(abs(a[jid] - b[jid]) * 57.29578, 2) for jid in a if abs(a[jid] - b[jid]) >= STILL_RAD}
            if moved:
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "坐着，但关节还在动（要 0.5 秒内每颗都 <1°）", {"moved_deg": moved})
            return "坐着、不动：原样冻住坐姿"
        if op.ctx.now() >= deadline:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"等了 {HOMING_WAIT:.0f} 秒还没到站姿保持：{v2[1]}")
        op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)

# calib-read / calib-commit：读标定，或者把舵机零位 / 方向 / IMU 方向写进 robotd 的标定文件
#
# 出厂镜像让主程序跑标定模式（--commissioning），第 3 步写成功时删掉镜像放的 drop-in，
# 让主程序回到运动模式。成功不只看 mode=motion：还要 phase=control，并且 calibration-status
# 读回来跟写进去的逐项一致。写文件从第一步开始无论哪里出错都先换回备份。

CALIB_ERR = re.compile(
    r"(calibrat|motion_enabled|IMU mounting|motion requires|Feetech configuration|invalid Feetech|"
    r"single-turn|limits exclude|official home|min_rad|max_rad|verified IMU)", re.I)


def check_calib_read_args(args):
    check_keys(args, ("by",), "calib-read 的参数")
    return check_by(args) if "by" in args else None


def exec_start(op):
    return show(op, "robotd", ["ExecStart"]).get("ExecStart", "")


def calib_mode(op, strict=True):
    """commissioning = 镜像放的 drop-in 在；motion = 不在且 ExecStart 也没有 --commissioning。
    ExecStart 有而 drop-in 不在：不是镜像设的，不敢自动删 / 切。calib-read 只读，strict=False
    如实报 "foreign"，好让人看见现状；calib-commit 必须 strict=True 拒绝。"""
    if exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN):
        return "commissioning", "标定模式，写完要切运动模式"
    start = exec_start(op)
    if "--commissioning" in start:
        if strict:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "foreign_commissioning",
                       "主程序的标定模式不是镜像设的，不敢自动切，去日志页导出诊断包",
                       {"ExecStart": start, "commissioning_file": COMMISSIONING_DROPIN})
        return "foreign", "ExecStart 里有 --commissioning，但镜像的 drop-in 不在（不是镜像设的，写入不敢自动切）"
    return "motion", "运动模式，只换标定"


def calib_posture(bus):
    """写标定前后的姿势门槛。只拦运动模式下策略在跑 / 还上着力的情况；标定模式照常放行。"""
    if not isinstance(bus, dict):
        return "refuse", "主程序回的 busStatus 不是对象"
    mode, phase = bus.get("mode"), bus.get("phase")
    if mode == "commissioning":
        return "ok", "标定模式"
    if mode != "motion":
        return "refuse", f"看不懂主程序现在的状态（mode={mode}，phase={phase}）"
    if phase in STARTING_PHASES:
        return "ok", f"主程序还在启动阶段（{phase}）"
    if phase == "waiting_for_bus":
        return "ok", "主程序还没打开舵机总线（没有策略在跑），可以重写标定"
    if phase != "control":
        return "refuse", f"主程序现在不是控制阶段（phase={phase}）"
    native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
    if bus.get("policy_enabled") is True or native.get("torque_state_confirmed") is True:
        return "refuse", "鸭子在走 / 站着：先坐下或卸力再写"
    if bus.get("home_recovery") is True:
        return "refuse", "LB 起身还没结束：等它回站姿再写"
    return "ok", "主程序在运动模式、没在走也没站着"


def calib_gate(op, mode):
    """隔 200 ms 读两次。commissioning 没有策略，按模式直接放行。"""
    if mode == "commissioning":
        op.emit("gate", "info", "标定模式：没有策略，照常写")
        return "标定模式"
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + HOMING_WAIT
    while True:
        if stopped(robotd_state(op)):
            return "主程序没在跑"
        try:
            r1 = read_robotd(op)
            op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)
            r2 = read_robotd(op)
        except RpcError as e:
            if stopped(robotd_state(op)):
                return "主程序没在跑"
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"主程序在跑，但不回话：{e}。等几秒再试") from e
        v1, v2 = calib_posture(r1[0]), calib_posture(r2[0])
        op.emit("gate", "info", "两次读主程序姿势", {"first": v1, "second": v2})
        if v1[0] == "refuse" or v2[0] == "refuse":
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", (v2 if v2[0] == "refuse" else v1)[1])
        if v1[0] == v2[0] == "ok":
            return v2[1]
        if op.ctx.now() >= deadline:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"等了 {HOMING_WAIT:.0f} 秒还没法判断姿势：{v2[1]}")
        op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)


def check_calib_commit_args(args):
    check_keys(args, ("by", "joints", "imu", "dry_run"), "calib-commit 的参数")
    by = check_by(args)
    joints = args.get("joints")
    if not isinstance(joints, list) or len(joints) != 15:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "joints 要正好 15 个 {id, direction}")
    rows = []
    for row in joints:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "joints 的每一行要是对象")
        check_keys(row, ("id", "direction"), "joints 的一行")
        if not is_int(row.get("id")) or row.get("direction") not in (-1, 1):
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "joints 的每一行要是 {id: 整数, direction: 1 或 -1}")
        rows.append({"id": row["id"], "direction": row["direction"]})
    imu = args.get("imu")
    if not isinstance(imu, dict):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "imu 要是一个对象")

    if imu.get("source") not in IMU_SOURCES:

def read_calibration(op):
    try:
        with open(op.ctx.p(CALIB), "rb") as f:
            data = tomllib.load(f)
        st = os.stat(op.ctx.p(CALIB))
    except FileNotFoundError as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "no_calibration", f"找不到主程序的标定文件：{CALIB}", {"path": CALIB}) from e
    except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_calibration", f"主程序的标定文件读不出来：{type(e).__name__}: {e}",
                   {"path": CALIB}) from e
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_calibration", "主程序的标定文件顶层不是对象", {"path": CALIB})
    return data, st


def _sha256(data):
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def file_meta(ctx, path):
    try:
        with open(ctx.p(path), "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
        st = os.stat(ctx.p(path))
        return {"existed": True, "mode": stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode), "uid": st.st_uid, "gid": st.st_gid,
                "size": len(data), "sha256": _sha256(data)}, data
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {"existed": False}, None
    except OSError as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "backup_failed", f"备份时读不到 {path}：{type(e).__name__}: {e}") from e


def calib_backup(op):
    """一组一个目录 calib-backups/<序号>-<时间>/：主文件、saved、commissioning（有就备）、manifest。
    序号按已有目录最大值 +1，不看墙钟（板子没有 RTC）。只留最近 10 组。"""
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, CALIB_BACKUP_DIR, 0o700)
    try:
        names = os.listdir(op.ctx.p(CALIB_BACKUP_DIR))
    except OSError as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "backup_failed", f"列不出旧备份：{type(e).__name__}: {e}") from e
    seq = 0
    for name in names:
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{4,})-", name)
        if m:
            seq = max(seq, int(m.group(1)))
    seq += 1
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
    path = f"{CALIB_BACKUP_DIR}/{seq:04d}-{stamp}"
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, path, 0o700)
    specs = [(CALIB, "hd1910-calibration.toml"), (CALIB_SAVED, "hd1910-calibration.saved.toml"),
             (COMMISSIONING_DROPIN, "zzzz-zz-microduck-commissioning.conf")]
    files = []
    for src, name in specs:
        meta, data = file_meta(op.ctx, src)
        row = {"path": src, "name": name, **meta}
        if meta["existed"]:
            write_atomic(op.ctx, f"{path}/{name}", data, 0o600)
        files.append(row)
    manifest = {"version": VERSION, "created": stamp, "by": getattr(op, "by", None), "files": files}
    write_atomic(op.ctx, f"{path}/manifest.json",
                 (json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o600)
    try:
        groups = sorted((n for n in os.listdir(op.ctx.p(CALIB_BACKUP_DIR))
                         if re.match(r"^\d{4,}-", n) and os.path.isdir(op.ctx.p(f"{CALIB_BACKUP_DIR}/{n}"))),
                        key=lambda n: int(n.split("-", 1)[0]))
        for old in groups[:-CALIB_BACKUPS_KEEP]:
            shutil.rmtree(op.ctx.p(f"{CALIB_BACKUP_DIR}/{old}"), ignore_errors=True)
    except OSError:
        pass
    op.emit("backup", "info", f"备份了写之前的文件：{path}", {"path": path, "keep": CALIB_BACKUPS_KEEP})
    return path


def _write_preserving(op, path, data, meta, default_mode):
    mode = int(meta.get("mode", default_mode)) if meta.get("existed") else default_mode
    uid = meta.get("uid") if meta.get("existed") else None
    gid = meta.get("gid") if meta.get("existed") else None
    write_atomic(op.ctx, path, data, mode, uid, gid)


def install_calibration(op, text, old, main_meta, saved_meta):
    """旧主文件留 .previous；主文件和 saved 各用自己原来的属主 / 权限原子写。"""
    _write_preserving(op, CALIB_PREVIOUS, old, main_meta, 0o644)
    op.emit("write", "info", f"旧文件留了一份：{CALIB_PREVIOUS}")
    payload = text.encode("utf-8")
    _write_preserving(op, CALIB, payload, main_meta, 0o644)
    _write_preserving(op, CALIB_SAVED, payload, saved_meta, int(main_meta.get("mode", 0o644)))
    op.emit("write", "info", f"写好了：{CALIB} 和 {CALIB_SAVED}，属主和权限照旧")


def _load_toml(op, path):

def verify_calibration_file(op, data, source):

        if not same_calibration(normalized_calibration(back), normalized_calibration(data)):
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "bad_toml", f"新写的 {path} 读回来跟要写的不一样")
        validate_calibration(back, source)
    op.emit("check", "info", "两个文件读回来逐项对过：15 颗、限位、IMU 方向都在")


def robotd_hello(op):

    except RpcError as e:

    if not isinstance(hello, dict):
        return False, "hello 回的不是对象"

def wait_robotd(op, what="主程序"):
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + CALIB_RESTART_WAIT
    last_emit = op.ctx.now()
    st = {}
    while op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        st = robotd_state(op)
        if st.get("ActiveState") == "active":
            ok, why = robotd_hello(op)
            if ok:
                op.emit("wait", "info", f"{what}起来了，hello 通了", {"robotd": st, "hello": why})
                return True, st
            st = dict(st, hello=why)
        if op.ctx.now() - last_emit >= 5.0:
            last_emit = op.ctx.now()
            op.emit("wait", "info", f"等{what}（ActiveState={st.get('ActiveState', '?')}）", st)
        op.ctx.sleep(0.25)
    return False, st


def robotd_bus_status(op):
    try:
        st = op.ctx.rpc("robot.busStatus", {}, 1.0)
    except RpcError as e:
        return None, str(e)
    if not isinstance(st, dict):
        return None, "busStatus 回的不是对象"
    return st, None


def calibration_status(op):
    try:
        r = op.ctx.rpc("robot.busCommand", {"action": "calibration-status"}, 2.0)
    except RpcError as e:
        return None, str(e)
    return (r, None) if isinstance(r, dict) else (None, "calibration-status 回的不是对象")


def status_summary(st):
    st = st if isinstance(st, dict) else {}
    return {"mode": st.get("mode"), "phase": st.get("phase"), "error": st.get("error")}


def _num_same(a, b):
    return (isinstance(a, (int, float)) and not isinstance(a, bool)
            and isinstance(b, (int, float)) and not isinstance(b, bool)
            and math.isclose(float(a), float(b), rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-9))


def _same_field(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, float) or isinstance(b, float):
        return _num_same(a, b)
    return a == b


def readback_mismatches(expected, calibration):
    """按 calibration_status() 的 calibration 逐项比：15 颗的 7 个字段、motion_enabled、
    总线小板的 quat / verified、imu_mounts 每一格。浮点容差 1e-9。"""
    got = calibration if isinstance(calibration, dict) else {}
    exp = expected if isinstance(expected, dict) else {}
    out = []

    def one(label, a, b):
        if not _same_field(a, b):
            out.append(f"{label}：写 {a!r}，读回 {b!r}")

    for key in ("motion_enabled", "imu_mount_verified", "imu_bus_protocol", "imu_bus_profile"):
        one(key, exp.get(key), got.get(key))
    one("imu_mount_quat", exp.get("imu_mount_quat"), got.get("imu_mount_quat"))
    ejs, gjs = exp.get("joints") if isinstance(exp.get("joints"), list) else [], got.get("joints") if isinstance(got.get("joints"), list) else []
    if len(ejs) != 15 or len(gjs) != 15:
        out.append(f"joints：写 {len(ejs)} 颗，读回 {len(gjs)} 颗")
    for i in range(min(len(ejs), len(gjs))):
        e, g = ejs[i] if isinstance(ejs[i], dict) else {}, gjs[i] if isinstance(gjs[i], dict) else {}
        for field in ("name", "id", "zero_raw", "direction", "calibrated", "min_rad", "max_rad"):
            one(f"joints[{i}].{field}", e.get(field), g.get(field))
    em = exp.get("imu_mounts") if isinstance(exp.get("imu_mounts"), dict) else {}
    gm = got.get("imu_mounts") if isinstance(got.get("imu_mounts"), dict) else {}
    for kind in sorted(set(em) | set(gm)):
        e = em.get(kind) if isinstance(em.get(kind), dict) else {}
        g = gm.get(kind) if isinstance(gm.get(kind), dict) else {}
        one(f"imu_mounts.{kind}.quat", e.get("quat"), g.get("quat"))
        one(f"imu_mounts.{kind}.verified", e.get("verified"), g.get("verified"))
    return out


def wait_motion(op, expected):
    """重启后每 0.5 秒看一次，最多 30 秒。成功 = motion + control + 标定逐项读回一致。
    waiting_for_bus 带标定校验的错误立刻判失败（重试也一样）；带别的错误（总线打不开）
    可能只是刚启动那一下，主程序每秒重试，等到 30 秒还这样才判失败。回一个可写进 last-result 的判定字典。"""
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + CALIB_MOTION_WAIT
    last, why = {}, None
    mismatches = []
    last_emit = op.ctx.now()
    while True:
        st, why = robotd_bus_status(op)
        if st is not None:
            last = st
        mode, phase, error = last.get("mode"), last.get("phase"), last.get("error")
        if phase == "waiting_for_bus" and error and CALIB_ERR.search(str(error)):
            return {"ok": False, "kind": "calib_rejected", "bus": last, "readback_ok": False,
                    "mismatches": [], "error": str(error)}
        if mode == "motion" and phase == "control":
            status, cs_err = calibration_status(op)
            if status is not None:
                mismatches = readback_mismatches(expected, status.get("calibration"))
                metadata_error = imu_bus_metadata(last)[2]
                if status.get("imu_source") in (None, "bus") and metadata_error:
                    mismatches.append(metadata_error)
                if not mismatches:
                    op.emit("wait", "info", "主程序进了运动模式，标定读回来逐项一致",
                            {"busStatus": status_summary(last), "readback_ok": True})
                    return {"ok": True, "kind": "committed", "bus": last, "status": status,
                            "readback_ok": True, "mismatches": []}
                op.emit("wait", "warn", f"标定读回来跟写进去的不一致（{len(mismatches)} 处）",
                        {"mismatches": mismatches[:20]})
            else:
                op.emit("wait", "info", f"已进控制阶段，标定还没读回来：{cs_err}", {"busStatus": status_summary(last)})
        if op.ctx.now() >= deadline:
            break
        if op.ctx.now() - last_emit >= 5.0:
            last_emit = op.ctx.now()
            op.emit("wait", "info",
                    f"等主程序进运动模式并读回标定（mode={mode or '?'}，phase={phase or '?'}）",
                    {"busStatus": status_summary(last), "mismatches": mismatches[:20]})
        op.ctx.sleep(CALIB_STATUS_INTERVAL)
    if not last and why:
        last = {"error": why}
    if mode == "motion" and phase == "control":
        kind = "readback_mismatch"
    elif phase == "waiting_for_bus" and last.get("error"):
        kind = "bus_unavailable"
    else:
        kind = "not_motion"
    return {"ok": False, "kind": kind, "bus": last, "readback_ok": False,
            "mismatches": mismatches, "error": last.get("error") or why}


def journal_tail(op):
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["journalctl", "-u", "robotd", "-n", "30", "--no-pager"], timeout=5.0)
    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in (out or "").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not lines and err:
        lines = _stderr_lines(err)
    return lines[-30:]


def restart_robotd(op, what="重启主程序"):
    op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "reset-failed", "robotd"])
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "restart", "robotd"], timeout=20.0)
    op.emit("restart", "info", what, {"rc": rc, "stderr": err.strip()[:300]})
    return rc == 0


def _restore_one(op, backup_dir, row, errors):
    path = row.get("path") if isinstance(row, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(path, str):
        errors.append("manifest 里有一项没有 path")
        return False
    try:
        if row.get("existed"):
            name = row.get("name")
            with open(op.ctx.p(f"{backup_dir}/{name}"), "rb") as f:
                data = f.read()
            if _sha256(data) != row.get("sha256"):
                raise OSError(f"备份文件 {name} 的 sha256 不对")
            _write_preserving(op, path, data, row, 0o644)
        elif exists(op.ctx, path):
            remove(op.ctx, path)
        return True
    except (OSError, Stop) as e:
        errors.append(f"{path}：{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        return False


def rollback(op, backup_path):
    """从备份把主文件 / saved / commissioning 各自换回。结果分开报，回滚自己失败也如实写。"""
    out = {"files_restored": False, "mode_restored": False, "robotd_up_after_rollback": False,
           "errors": [], "backup": backup_path}
    try:
        with open(op.ctx.p(f"{backup_path}/manifest.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            manifest = json.load(f)
        rows = manifest.get("files") if isinstance(manifest, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            raise ValueError("manifest 里没有 files")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        out["errors"].append(f"读不了备份 manifest：{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        return out
    by_path = {r.get("path"): r for r in rows if isinstance(r, dict)}
    ok = True
    for path in (CALIB, CALIB_SAVED):
        ok = _restore_one(op, backup_path, by_path.get(path) or {"path": path, "existed": False}, out["errors"]) and ok
    crow = by_path.get(COMMISSIONING_DROPIN) or {"path": COMMISSIONING_DROPIN, "existed": False}
    mode_ok = _restore_one(op, backup_path, crow, out["errors"])
    out["files_restored"] = bool(ok)                    # 只算 .toml / .saved.toml，模式另外报
    out["mode_restored"] = bool(mode_ok and exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN) == bool(crow.get("existed")))
    op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])
    op.emit("rollback", "warn", "已经把标定文件和标定模式换回写之前的样子", out)
    restart_robotd(op, "再起一次主程序（用原来的文件）")
    up, rst = wait_robotd(op, "回滚后的主程序")
    out["robotd_up_after_rollback"] = bool(up)
    out["robotd"] = rst
    if not up:
        out["errors"].append("回滚后主程序没在 40 秒内回 hello")
    op.emit("rollback", "info" if up else "error",
            "回滚后主程序起来了" if up else "回滚后主程序没起来：去日志页导出诊断包",
            {"robotd_up_after_rollback": up})
    return out


def _rollback_words(rb):
    if not isinstance(rb, dict):
        return "；回滚结果不知道，去日志页导出诊断包"
    if rb.get("files_restored") and rb.get("mode_restored") and rb.get("robotd_up_after_rollback"):
        return "；已经换回原来的文件和模式，又起了一次主程序"
    bits = []
    if not rb.get("files_restored"):
        bits.append("文件没完全换回")
    if not rb.get("mode_restored"):
        bits.append("标定 / 运动模式没换回")
    if not rb.get("robotd_up_after_rollback"):
        bits.append("主程序回滚后没起来")
    return "；回滚没完全成功（" + "、".join(bits) + "），去日志页导出诊断包"


def _commit_detail(base, judged, rb=None, journal=None):
    d = dict(base)
    d["bus_status"] = status_summary((judged or {}).get("bus"))
    d["readback_ok"] = bool((judged or {}).get("readback_ok"))
    d["mismatches"] = list((judged or {}).get("mismatches") or [])
    if journal is not None:
        d["journal"] = journal
    if rb is not None:
        d["rolled_back"] = bool(rb.get("files_restored") and rb.get("mode_restored")
                                and rb.get("robotd_up_after_rollback"))
        d["files_restored"] = bool(rb.get("files_restored"))
        d["mode_restored"] = bool(rb.get("mode_restored"))
        d["robotd_up_after_rollback"] = bool(rb.get("robotd_up_after_rollback"))
        d["rollback"] = rb
    return d


def _commit_fail(op, kind, why, base, judged, journal):
    rb = rollback(op, base["backup"])
    detail = _commit_detail(base, judged, rb, journal)
    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, kind, why + _rollback_words(rb), detail)


def verb_calib_read(op, args):

def verb_calib_commit(op, args, raw):
    by, joints, imu, dry = check_calib_commit_args(args)
    op.by = by
    if not dry and op.ctx.env.get(DETACH_ENV) != "1":
        return detach(op, raw, "calib-commit")
    # 先拿锁再查旗：跟 bus-take / bus-give-back 共用 helper.lock
    op.take_lock("写标定")
    imu_redo_conflict(op)
    if flag_present(op.ctx):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bus_held", "舵机页正占着总线：先在舵机页点「交还主程序」再写")
    op.emit("bus", "info", "舵机页没占着总线，可以写")
    mode, mode_text = calib_mode(op)
    op.emit("mode", "info", mode_text, {"mode": mode, "commissioning_file": COMMISSIONING_DROPIN})
    why = calib_gate(op, mode)
    data, st = read_calibration(op)
    rows = data.get("joints") if isinstance(data.get("joints"), list) else []
    if imu["source"] == "bus":
        live, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
        info, configured, metadata_error = imu_bus_metadata(live)
        if metadata_error:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", metadata_error)
        if configured is not None or data.get("imu_bus_profile") == "qinmo":
            if (not isinstance(info, dict) or info.get("profile", "legacy") != data.get("imu_bus_profile", "legacy")
                    or configured != info.get("profile", "legacy")
                    or info.get("protocol") != data.get("imu_bus_protocol", "feetech")):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "总线 IMU 类型与已验证方向不一致：先到 IMU 页重新标定")
            status, err = calibration_status(op)
            top = (status or {}).get("imu_mount")
            if (status is None or imu_redo_source(live, status) != "bus"
                    or (configured == "qinmo" and (data.get("imu_mount_verified") is not True
                        or (isinstance(top, dict) and top.get("verified") is not True)))):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "Qinmo 安装方向还未由主程序验证，不能跳过")
    file_ids = {r.get("id") for r in rows if isinstance(r, dict)}
    given = {r["id"] for r in joints}
    if file_ids != given:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "joint_mismatch",
                   f"这次的 15 颗（{sorted(given)}）跟主程序文件里的（{sorted(file_ids, key=str)}）对不上",
                   {"file_ids": sorted(file_ids, key=str), "given": sorted(given)})
    op.emit("read", "info", f"读了主程序的标定：{len(rows)} 颗，id 对得上")

    try:
        built = build_calibration(data, joints, imu)
        validate_calibration(built, imu["source"])
    except CalibError as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "invalid", f"要写的内容没过校验：{e}") from e
    op.emit("build", "info", "按标准限位、这次的方向和 IMU 方向组好了新内容")
    text = render_calibration(built)
    back = tomllib.loads(text)
    if not same_calibration(normalized_calibration(back), normalized_calibration(built)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "bad_toml", "自己写出来的 TOML 跟要写的数据对不上")
    validate_calibration(back, imu["source"])
    op.emit("check", "info", "写之前校验过了：15 颗、限位、IMU 方向都合规")

    if dry:
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "preview", "预览好了：没写文件、没重启",
                         {"toml": text, "by": by, "source": imu["source"], "dry_run": True,
                          "mode": mode, "gate": why})

    backup_path = calib_backup(op)
    with open(op.ctx.p(f"{backup_path}/manifest.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        manifest = json.load(f)
    metas = {r.get("path"): r for r in manifest.get("files") or [] if isinstance(r, dict)}
    main_meta = metas.get(CALIB) or {"existed": True, "mode": stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),
                                     "uid": st.st_uid, "gid": st.st_gid}
    saved_meta = metas.get(CALIB_SAVED) or {"existed": False}
    try:
        with open(op.ctx.p(CALIB), "rb") as f:
            old = f.read()
    except OSError as e:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "read_failed", f"写之前读不到现在的文件：{type(e).__name__}: {e}") from e
    base = {"by": by, "backup": backup_path, "toml": text, "source": imu["source"],
            "mode_before": mode, "mode_text": mode_text, "gate": why}
    journal = []
    judged = None
    try:
        install_calibration(op, text, old, main_meta, saved_meta)
        verify_calibration_file(op, built, imu["source"])
        if mode == "commissioning":
            if not remove(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN):
                raise OSError(f"commissioning 文件不见了：{COMMISSIONING_DROPIN}")
            op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])
            op.emit("mode", "info", "删掉出厂标定模式 drop-in，主程序下次启动进运动模式")
        restart_robotd(op)
        up, rst = wait_robotd(op)
        base["robotd"] = rst
        journal = journal_tail(op)
        if not up:
            return _commit_fail(op, "restart_failed", "写进去了，但主程序没在 40 秒内起来（没连上 hello）",
                                base, {"bus": None, "readback_ok": False, "mismatches": []}, journal)
        judged = wait_motion(op, built)
        if judged.get("ok"):
            detail = _commit_detail(base, judged, None, journal)
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "committed",
                             "写进主程序了：主程序进了运动模式，15 颗和 IMU 方向读回来都一致", detail)
        bus = status_summary(judged.get("bus"))
        if judged.get("kind") == "calib_rejected":
            why = f"标定没通过主程序的检查：{judged.get('error')}"
        elif judged.get("kind") == "bus_unavailable":
            why = f"主程序打不开舵机总线：{judged.get('error')}。舵机电源开了吗？"
        elif judged.get("kind") == "readback_mismatch":
            first = (judged.get("mismatches") or ["没读到 calibration-status"])[0]
            why = f"主程序进了运动模式，但标定读回来跟写进去的不一致：{first}"
        else:
            stuck = bus.get("error") or f"mode={bus.get('mode') or '?'}，phase={bus.get('phase') or '?'}"
            why = f"等 30 秒主程序还没进运动模式：{stuck}"
        return _commit_fail(op, judged.get("kind") or "not_motion", why, base, judged, journal)
    except Stop as e:
        rb = rollback(op, backup_path)
        detail = _commit_detail(base, judged, rb, journal_tail(op))
        if isinstance(e.detail, dict):
            detail.update({k: v for k, v in e.detail.items() if k not in detail})
        reason = f"写到一半出错：{e.reason}" + _rollback_words(rb)
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, e.result, reason, detail)
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 —— 第一次写开始以后任何异常都先回滚
        rb = rollback(op, backup_path)
        detail = _commit_detail(base, judged, rb, journal_tail(op))
        reason = f"写到一半出错：{type(e).__name__}: {e}" + _rollback_words(rb)
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "write_failed", reason, detail)

def imu_redo_file(op, path):
    """Only root-owned regular files; never follow a caller's symlink."""
    st = os.lstat(op.ctx.p(path))
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or (op.ctx.check_owner and (st.st_uid != 0 or st.st_mode & 0o022)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", f"IMU 会话文件不安全：{path}")
    with open(op.ctx.p(path), "rb") as stream:
        return stream.read()


def imu_redo_arguments(description):
    # systemctl's ExecStart has one record, with an explicitly direct robotd executable.
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\{\s*path=([^;{}]+?)\s*;\s*argv\[\]=([^{}]*?)\s*;\s*(?:ignore_errors=[^{}]*?)?\}",
                         description.strip(), re.S)
    if not match:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_exec", "读不清主程序唯一的实际启动命令：未修改服务")
    if re.search(r"\\(?:x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[0-7]{3}|[nrt])|[$%]", match.group(2)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_exec", "启动参数含无法确定的转义 / 环境展开：未修改服务")
    try:
        argv = shlex.split(match.group(2))
    except ValueError as err:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_exec", "主程序启动参数有歧义：未修改服务") from err
    path = match.group(1).strip()
    if (not argv or argv[0] != path or not path.startswith("/") or path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] != "robotd"
            or any(any(c in a for c in "\n\r\0") for a in argv)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_exec", "主程序使用包装命令或不明确的参数：未修改服务")
    return argv


def imu_redo_quote(argument):
    return '"' + argument.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"').replace('%', '%%').replace('$', '$$') + '"'


def imu_redo_override(manifest):
    return ("# Owned by microduck-helper imu-recalibrate: " + manifest["session_id"] +
            "\n[Service]\nExecStart=\nExecStart=" +
            " ".join(imu_redo_quote(a) for a in manifest["exec_args"] + ["--commissioning"]) + "\n").encode()


def imu_redo_load(op):
    if not exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_MANIFEST):
        return None
    try:
        # Check each enclosing persistent directory, including when this is a resumed session.
        for path in (OPLOG_DIR, IMU_REDO_DIR):
            st = os.lstat(op.ctx.p(path))
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) or (op.ctx.check_owner and (st.st_uid != 0 or st.st_mode & 0o022)):
                raise ValueError("会话目录不安全")
        m = json.loads(imu_redo_file(op, IMU_REDO_MANIFEST))
        if (m.get("schema") != IMU_REDO_SCHEMA or type(m.get("active")) is not bool
                or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", m.get("session_id", ""))
                or m.get("source") not in IMU_SOURCES or not isinstance(m.get("exec_args"), list)
                or not all(isinstance(a, str) for a in m["exec_args"])
                or not m["exec_args"] or "--commissioning" in m["exec_args"]):
            raise ValueError("manifest 格式不对")
        expected_paths = (CALIB, CALIB_SAVED)
        if (not isinstance(m.get("files"), list) or len(m["files"]) != 2
                or tuple(row.get("path") for row in m["files"]) != expected_paths
                or tuple(row.get("name") for row in m["files"]) != ("main.toml", "saved.toml")):
            raise ValueError("备份清单格式不对")
        if m.get("override_sha256") != _sha256(imu_redo_override(m)):
            raise ValueError("模式文件摘要不对")
        if "profile" in m:
            if (m["profile"] not in ("legacy", "qinmo") or m.get("original_mode") not in ("motion", "commissioning", "startup")
                    or tuple(row.get("path") for row in m.get("config_files", [])) != (IMU_CONFIG, IMU_CONFIG_SAVED)
                    or tuple(row.get("name") for row in m.get("config_files", [])) != ("config.toml", "config-saved.toml")):
                raise ValueError("类型备份清单格式不对")
        if m["active"]:
            directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + m["session_id"]
            st = os.lstat(op.ctx.p(directory))
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) or (op.ctx.check_owner and (st.st_uid != 0 or st.st_mode & 0o022)):
                raise ValueError("备份目录不安全")
            for row in m["files"] + m.get("config_files", []):
                if row.get("existed") and _sha256(imu_redo_file(op, directory + "/" + row["name"])) != row.get("sha256"):
                    raise ValueError("备份摘要不对")
            raw = imu_redo_file(op, directory + "/calibration.json")
            if _sha256(raw) != m.get("calibration_sha256"):
                raise ValueError("标定快照摘要不对")
        return m
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError) as err:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", f"IMU 会话读不回来或已改变：{err}；保留现场") from err


def imu_redo_conflict(op):
    m = imu_redo_load(op)
    if (m and m["active"]) or exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_recalibrate_active", "初次 IMU 校准正在重做：先完成或取消，再操作舵机 / 写整份标定")


def imu_redo_save(op, manifest, phase, **fields):
    manifest.update(phase=phase, **fields)
    write_atomic(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_MANIFEST, (json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n").encode(), 0o644)


def imu_redo_source(bus, status):
    native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
    sample = (bus.get("last_sample") or {}).get("imu") or {}
    source = native.get("imu_source") or sample.get("source") or status.get("imu_source")
    if source not in IMU_SOURCES or status.get("imu_source") != source:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_source_changed", "当前 IMU 来源读回不一致：停止重做")
    return source


def imu_redo_same(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        return set(a) == set(b) and all(imu_redo_same(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list):
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(imu_redo_same(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    if isinstance(a, bool) or isinstance(b, bool):
        return a is b
    if isinstance(a, (float, int)) and isinstance(b, (float, int)):
        return _num_same(a, b)
    return a == b


def imu_redo_gate(op, mode, source=None):
    """Require two fresh, confirmed off snapshots; unknown is not torque-off."""
    for i in range(2):
        if i:
            op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)
        bus, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
        if bus is None:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"主程序状态读不回：{err}")
        native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
        hd = native.get("hd1910") if isinstance(native.get("hd1910"), dict) else {}
        safe = bus.get("mode") == mode and bus.get("torque_off_pending") is not True and not bus.get("home_recovery")
        if mode == "motion":
            safe = (safe and bus.get("phase") == "control" and bus.get("policy_enabled") is False
                    and native.get("torque_state_confirmed") is False
                    and hd.get("restore_pending") is False and hd.get("temporary_gains_applied") is False)
        else:
            safe = (safe and bus.get("phase") in COMMISSIONING_UP and bus.get("torque_state") == "off"
                    and not bus.get("motion") and not (bus.get("hold") or {}).get("active")
                    and bus.get("policy_motion_enabled") is not True)
        if not safe:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "先扶稳鸭子并卸力，等主程序明确确认全部失能、临时增益恢复，再重做初次 IMU 校准")
        if source is not None:
            status, err = calibration_status(op)
            if status is None or imu_redo_source(bus, status) != source:
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_source_changed", "IMU 来源已改变或读不回，停止重做")
    return bus


def imu_redo_readback(op, expected, source, quat=None):
    bus, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
    status, cs_err = calibration_status(op)
    if bus is None or status is None or imu_redo_source(bus, status) != source:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", f"当前 IMU 来源读不回：{err or cs_err or source}")
    cal = status.get("calibration")
    if not imu_redo_same(normalized_calibration(expected), normalized_calibration(cal or {})):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "主程序标定读回与文件逐项不一致：保留会话")
    info, configured, metadata_error = imu_bus_metadata(bus)
    if source == "bus" and metadata_error:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", metadata_error)
    if quat is not None:
        if (source == "bus" and isinstance(info, dict)
                and (info.get("protocol") != cal.get("imu_bus_protocol", "feetech")
                     or info.get("profile", "legacy") != cal.get("imu_bus_profile", "legacy")
                     or info.get("profile", "legacy") not in ("legacy", "qinmo"))):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "当前总线 IMU 协议 / 类型与已验证的安装方向标定不匹配")
        if source == "bus" and imu_profile_configured(bus) is not None and not isinstance(info, dict):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "当前总线 IMU 还未连接，不能确认安装方向")
        mount = ({"quat": cal.get("imu_mount_quat"), "verified": cal.get("imu_mount_verified")}
                 if source == "bus" else (cal.get("imu_mounts") or {}).get(source) or {})
        top = status.get("imu_mount")
        if mount.get("verified") is not True or not imu_redo_same(mount.get("quat"), quat):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "新 IMU 方向 / verified 没有逐项读回")
        if isinstance(top, dict) and (top.get("verified") is not True or not imu_redo_same(top.get("quat"), quat)):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "主程序当前生效的 IMU 方向不一致")
    return status


def imu_redo_owned(op, m, allow_missing=False):
    if not exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN):
        if allow_missing:
            # A killed helper may have unlinked its override either before or
            # after daemon-reload. Both loaded commands are pinned known forms;
            # neither tells us which mode the still-running process is using.
            loaded = imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op))
            if loaded not in (m["exec_args"], m["exec_args"] + ["--commissioning"]):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "会话中断后主程序生效的启动参数已改变：保留现场")
            return
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "IMU 会话自己的模式文件不见了：保留现场")
    if imu_redo_file(op, IMU_REDO_DROPIN) != imu_redo_override(m):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "IMU 会话模式文件已改变，不删除别人的内容")
    loaded = imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op))
    if (loaded != m["exec_args"] + ["--commissioning"]
            and not (allow_missing and loaded == m["exec_args"])):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "主程序生效的启动参数已改变：保留现场")


def imu_redo_restart(op, mode, expected, source):
    if not restart_robotd(op) or not wait_robotd(op)[0]:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "主程序重启失败，会话保留，可重试或取消")
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + CALIB_MOTION_WAIT
    while True:
        bus, _ = robotd_bus_status(op)
        if bus and bus.get("mode") == mode and bus.get("phase") == ("control" if mode == "motion" else "ready"):
            break
        if op.ctx.now() >= deadline:
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "主程序还没回到预期模式，会话保留")
        op.ctx.sleep(CALIB_STATUS_INTERVAL)
    # Motion startup may need a bounded relax to confirm the torque readback.
    if mode == "motion" and (bus.get("native") or {}).get("torque_state_confirmed") is not False:
        op.ctx.rpc("robot.relax", {}, 3.0)
    imu_redo_gate(op, mode, source)
    return imu_redo_readback(op, expected, source)


def imu_redo_restore_original(op, m):
    if "profile" in m:
        return imu_profile_restore(op, m)
    errors = []
    directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + m["session_id"]
    for row in m["files"]:
        if not _restore_one(op, directory, row, errors):
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "; ".join(errors))
    imu_redo_owned(op, m, allow_missing=True)
    remove(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN)
    if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0 or imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != m["exec_args"]:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "原来的启动参数没恢复，会话保留")
    expected = _load_toml(op, CALIB)
    status = imu_redo_restart(op, "motion", expected, m["source"])
    pads_restore(op, m["controllers"])
    imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelled", active=False)
    return status


def imu_bus_metadata(bus):
    """Validate raw presence before projection; mirrored in the standalone helper."""
    bus = bus if isinstance(bus, dict) else {}
    native = bus.get("native") if isinstance(bus.get("native"), dict) else {}
    infos = [part["imu_bus"] for part in (native, bus) if "imu_bus" in part]
    profiles = [part["configured_imu_profile"] for part in (native, bus) if "configured_imu_profile" in part]
    error = None
    for info in infos:
        if (not isinstance(info, dict) or info.get("protocol") not in ("feetech", "dxl2")
                or info.get("profile", "legacy") not in ("legacy", "qinmo")
                or (info.get("profile") == "qinmo" and info.get("protocol") != "feetech")):
            error = "主程序报告了不支持或不一致的 IMU 协议 / 类型：待确认，不能使用旧方向或继续标定"
    if any(profile not in ("legacy", "qinmo") for profile in profiles):
        error = "主程序报告了不支持或不一致的 IMU 协议 / 类型：待确认，不能使用旧方向或继续标定"
    if not error:
        bindings = [(info["protocol"], info.get("profile", "legacy")) for info in infos]
        if (any(binding != bindings[0] for binding in bindings[1:])
                or any(profile != profiles[0] for profile in profiles[1:])
                or (bindings and profiles and bindings[0][1] != profiles[0])):
            error = "主程序报告了不支持或不一致的 IMU 协议 / 类型：待确认，不能使用旧方向或继续标定"
    return (infos[0] if infos and isinstance(infos[0], dict) else None,
            profiles[0] if profiles else None, error)

def imu_profile_configured(bus):
    return imu_bus_metadata(bus)[1]


def imu_profile_controllers_stop(op):
    pads_stop(op)
    # R3 listening can remain latched after padd stops and issue direct sit/stand.

    if was.get("duck_echo"):
