def imu_profile_safe_file(op, path):
    # Check every ancestor: lstat on the leaf alone still follows a symlinked parent.
    parts = path.strip("/").split("/")
    for index in range(1, len(parts)):
        st = os.lstat(op.ctx.p("/" + "/".join(parts[:index])))
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) or (op.ctx.check_owner and (st.st_uid != 0 or st.st_mode & 0o022)):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsafe_config", "主程序配置目录的属主 / 权限不安全，未修改")
    return imu_redo_file(op, path)


def imu_profile_config(op, argv):
    values = [argv[i + 1] for i, arg in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if arg == "--params"]
    sockets = [argv[i + 1] for i, arg in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if arg == "--socket"]
    if (values != [IMU_CONFIG] or sockets != [SOCK]
            or any(a.startswith(("--params=", "--socket=")) or a in ("--read-only", "--config", "--fake") for a in argv)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_config", "主程序未使用受支持的固定配置路径，未修改")
    dropins = show(op, "robotd", ["DropInPaths"]).get("DropInPaths", "").split()
    allowed = {"/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-r17-0151.conf",
               "/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-studio-bus.conf", COMMISSIONING_DROPIN, IMU_REDO_DROPIN}
    if not dropins or set(dropins) - allowed:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_exec", "主程序存在未支持的服务覆盖，未修改")
    # The executable and its ancestors are also pinned to safe root-owned files.
    if op.ctx.check_owner:
        imu_profile_safe_file(op, argv[0])
    result = []
    for path in (IMU_CONFIG, IMU_CONFIG_SAVED):
        raw = imu_profile_safe_file(op, path)
        try:
            data = tomllib.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as err:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "主程序配置读不回，未修改") from err
        bus = data.get("bus") or {}
        if (bus.get("protocol") != "feetech" or bus.get("imu_protocol", "auto") not in ("auto", "feetech", "dxl2")
                or bus.get("imu_profile", "legacy") not in ("legacy", "qinmo")
                or (data.get("trunk_imu") or {}).get("source", "bus") != "bus"
                or data.get("feetech_calibration") != CALIB):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_config", "类型选择只支持 Feetech 舵机总线的 IMU；当前配置不匹配")
        result.append((path, raw, data))
    return result


def imu_profile_text(raw, profile):
    """Patch only two scalar keys, including the image's quoted TOML spelling.

    Parsing before and after is authoritative. Ambiguous syntax is refused rather
    than reserializing policy tables or making a general configuration editor.
    """
    import copy
    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    data = tomllib.loads(text)
    expected = copy.deepcopy(data)
    expected["bus"].update(imu_profile=profile, imu_protocol="feetech" if profile == "qinmo" else "auto")
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    headers = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[\s*(?:bus|"bus"|\x27bus\x27)\s*\]\s*(?:#[^\n]*)?\n?', line)]
    if len(headers) != 1:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "bus 段没有唯一的受支持写法，未修改")
    start = headers[0] + 1
    end = next((i for i in range(start, len(lines)) if re.match(r"\s*\[", lines[i])), len(lines))
    block = lines[start:end]
    for key in ("imu_profile", "imu_protocol"):
        pattern = re.compile(r'\s*(?:' + key + '|"' + key + '"|\x27' + key + r'\x27)\s*=')
        matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(block) if pattern.match(line)]
        replacement = key + ' = "' + expected["bus"][key] + '"\n'
        if len(matches) > 1:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "类型字段重复，未修改")
        if matches:
            block[matches[0]] = replacement
        else:
            block.insert(0, replacement)
    if start and not lines[start-1].endswith("\n"):
        lines[start-1] += "\n"
    result = "".join(lines[:start] + block + lines[end:]).encode()
    if not imu_redo_same(tomllib.loads(result.decode()), expected):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "类型修改会改变其他配置，未修改")
    return result


def imu_profile_unverify(raw):
    import copy
    data = tomllib.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    expected = copy.deepcopy(data)
    expected["imu_mount_verified"] = False
    text, count = re.subn(r'(?m)^\s*(?:imu_mount_verified|"imu_mount_verified"|\x27imu_mount_verified\x27)\s*=\s*(?:true|false)\s*(?:#[^\n]*)?$',
                          'imu_mount_verified = false', raw.decode("utf-8"))
    if count != 1 or not imu_redo_same(tomllib.loads(text), expected):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "安装方向确认字段没有唯一的安全写法，未修改")
    return text.encode()


def imu_profile_gate(op):
    """Control uses the existing strict gate; pre-control proves lifecycle only."""
    for index in range(2):
        if index:
            op.ctx.sleep(GATE_GAP)
        bus, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
        info, profile, metadata_error = imu_bus_metadata(bus)
        if metadata_error:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_daemon", metadata_error)
        if profile not in ("legacy", "qinmo"):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "unsupported_daemon", "主程序版本尚不支持网页选择 IMU 类型：请先由维护者更新主程序")
        mode, phase = bus.get("mode"), bus.get("phase")
        if mode == "motion" and phase == "control":
            imu_redo_gate(op, "motion")
        elif (mode in ("motion", "commissioning") and phase in ("configuring_bus", "waiting_for_bus")
              and not bus.get("policy_enabled") and not bus.get("policy_motion_enabled")
              and not bus.get("motion") and not bus.get("home_recovery") and not bus.get("hold")):
            if not running(robotd_state(op)):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "主程序启动状态无法确认，未修改")
        elif mode == "commissioning" and phase in COMMISSIONING_UP:
            imu_redo_gate(op, "commissioning")
        else:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "主程序处于未知 / 活动状态：先扶稳并卸力，未修改类型")
    return bus


def imu_profile_readback(op, profile, require_discovery=False):
    bus, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
    info, configured, metadata_error = imu_bus_metadata(bus)
    if metadata_error:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", metadata_error)
    if bus is None or configured != profile:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "主程序配置类型没有准确读回，会话保留")
    if ((isinstance(info, dict) and (info.get("profile", "legacy") != profile
                                    or (profile == "qinmo" and info.get("protocol") != "feetech")))
            or (require_discovery and not isinstance(info, dict))):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "实际连接的 IMU 类型未读回一致，不能完成")
    return bus


def imu_profile_restart(op, profile):
    if not restart_robotd(op) or not wait_robotd(op)[0]:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "重连主程序失败，可取消恢复原参数")
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + CALIB_MOTION_WAIT
    while True:
        bus = imu_profile_readback(op, profile)
        if bus.get("mode") == "commissioning" and bus.get("phase") in (*COMMISSIONING_UP, "configuring_bus", "waiting_for_bus"):
            break
        if op.ctx.now() >= deadline:
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "尚未回到标定模式，可取消恢复原参数")
        op.ctx.sleep(CALIB_STATUS_INTERVAL)
    imu_profile_gate(op)
    return bus


def imu_profile_restore(op, m):
    imu_redo_owned(op, m, allow_missing=True)
    errors = []
    directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + m["session_id"]
    for row in m["files"] + m["config_files"]:
        imu_profile_safe_file(op, row["path"])
        if not _restore_one(op, directory, row, errors):
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "; ".join(errors))
    # Startup recovery never returns to control automatically, even on cancellation.
    if m["original_mode"] == "startup":
        # Hand off to the same fixed factory commissioning flow used by firstboot.
        # This permits a fresh selection / verification / normal firstboot commit.
        recovery = ("# microduck-helper: recovered pre-control IMU selection\n[Service]\nExecStart=\nExecStart=" +
                    " ".join(imu_redo_quote(a) for a in m["exec_args"] + ["--commissioning"]) + "\n").encode()
        if exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN) and imu_profile_safe_file(op, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN) != recovery:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "出厂标定模式文件已改变，保留会话")
        write_atomic(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN, recovery, 0o644)
        remove(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN)
        if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0 or imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != m["exec_args"] + ["--commissioning"]:
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "安全标定启动参数未加载，会话保留")
        imu_profile_restart(op, m["old_profile"])
        imu_profile_controllers_restore(op, m["controllers"])
        imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelled", active=False, reason="已恢复原类型，保持标定模式；可重新选择并验证")
        return {}
    remove(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN)
    target = m.get("original_args", m["exec_args"])
    if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0 or imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != target:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "原启动参数未恢复，会话保留")
    expected = _load_toml(op, CALIB)
    mode = m["original_mode"]
    if mode == "commissioning":
        imu_profile_restart(op, m["old_profile"])
        status = imu_redo_readback(op, expected, m["source"])
    else:
        status = imu_redo_restart(op, mode, expected, m["source"])
    imu_profile_controllers_restore(op, m["controllers"])
    imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelled", active=False)
    return status


def imu_profile_enter(op, args, previous):
    if (previous and previous["active"]) or exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_recalibrate_active", "标定会话已经开着：先完成或取消")
    original_args = imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op))
    factory = exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN)
    if ("--commissioning" in original_args) != factory or original_args.count("--commissioning") > 1:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "foreign_commissioning", "外来标定启动参数，未修改")
    argv = [a for a in original_args if a != "--commissioning"]
    configs = imu_profile_config(op, argv)
    # Build and validate every candidate before writing any file.
    candidates = {path: imu_profile_text(raw, args["profile"]) for path, raw, data in configs}
    bus = imu_profile_gate(op)
    status, err = calibration_status(op)
    if status is None or imu_redo_source(bus, status) != "bus":
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_source_changed", "当前主程序 IMU 来源不是总线或无法确认，未修改")
    if imu_profile_configured(bus) != configs[0][2]["bus"].get("imu_profile", "legacy"):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "文件类型与正在运行的主程序不一致，未修改")
    data, _ = read_calibration(op)
    imu_redo_readback(op, data, "bus")
    mode = "commissioning" if factory else ("motion" if bus.get("phase") == "control" else "startup")
    controllers = {"padd": is_active(op, "padd"), "gamesir": is_active(op, GAMESIR),
                   "duck_echo": is_active(op, "duck-echo")}
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, OPLOG_DIR, 0o755)
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DIR, 0o755)
    session = secrets.token_hex(16)
    directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + session
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, directory, 0o700)
    files, config_files = [], []
    for path, name, rows in ((CALIB, "main.toml", files), (CALIB_SAVED, "saved.toml", files),
                              (IMU_CONFIG, "config.toml", config_files), (IMU_CONFIG_SAVED, "config-saved.toml", config_files)):
        contents = imu_profile_safe_file(op, path)
        if rows is files:
            candidates[path] = imu_profile_unverify(contents)
        meta, _ = file_meta(op.ctx, path)
        meta.update(path=path, name=name)
        if rows is config_files:
            meta["selected_sha256"] = _sha256(candidates[path])
        write_atomic(op.ctx, directory + "/" + name, contents, 0o600)
        rows.append(meta)
    baseline = (json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    write_atomic(op.ctx, directory + "/calibration.json", baseline, 0o600)
    m = {"schema": IMU_REDO_SCHEMA, "active": True, "session_id": session, "source": "bus",
         "exec_args": argv, "original_args": original_args, "original_mode": mode, "profile": args["profile"],
         "old_profile": imu_profile_configured(bus), "files": files, "config_files": config_files,
         "controllers": controllers, "calibration_sha256": _sha256(baseline)}
    m["override_sha256"] = _sha256(imu_redo_override(m))
    imu_redo_save(op, m, "entering")
    changed = False
    try:
        imu_profile_controllers_stop(op)
        imu_profile_gate(op)
        if imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != original_args:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "主程序启动参数已改变，未修改")
        for row in files + config_files:
            if _sha256(imu_profile_safe_file(op, row["path"])) != row["sha256"]:
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "配置 / 标定在进入前改变，未修改")
        changed = True
        write_atomic(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN, imu_redo_override(m), 0o644)
        for row in config_files + files:
            _write_preserving(op, row["path"], candidates[row["path"]], row, 0o644)
            if imu_profile_safe_file(op, row["path"]) != candidates[row["path"]]:
                raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "readback_mismatch", "类型配置写后读回不一致")
        if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0:
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "模式配置未加载")
        imu_redo_owned(op, m)
        imu_profile_restart(op, m["profile"])
        imu_redo_save(op, m, "commissioning")
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "imu_entered", "类型已保存，已重连到标定模式；请完成安装方向采集与主程序验证", m)
    except Exception as err:
        try:
            if changed:
                imu_profile_restore(op, m)
            else:
                imu_profile_controllers_restore(op, controllers)
                imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelled", active=False)
        except Exception as rollback_error:
            imu_redo_save(op, m, "recovery_required", reason=str(rollback_error))
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", "选择未完成，恢复也未完成；会话和备份仍在，可取消恢复", m)
        return op.finish(err.code if isinstance(err, Stop) else EXIT_FAIL,
                         err.result if isinstance(err, Stop) else "enter_failed", str(err), m)


def check_imu_redo_args(args):
    action = args.get("action")
    keys = {"enter": ("by", "action", "confirmed", "profile"), "status": ("by", "action"),
            "cancel": ("by", "action", "confirmed", "session_id"),
            "finish": ("by", "action", "session_id", "source", "quat")}
    if action not in keys:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "imu-recalibrate 只认 enter / status / finish / cancel")
    check_keys(args, keys[action], "imu-recalibrate 的参数")
    if "profile" in args and args["profile"] not in ("legacy", "qinmo"):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "profile 只能是 legacy 或 qinmo")
    by = check_by(args)
    if action in ("enter", "cancel") and args.get("confirmed") is not True:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "先明确确认扶稳并卸力，再进入或取消")
    if action in ("finish", "cancel") and not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", str(args.get("session_id", ""))):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "session_id 不正确")
    if action == "finish":
        try:
            q = normalize_quat(args.get("quat"))
        except CalibError as err:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", str(err)) from err
        if args.get("source") not in IMU_SOURCES or not imu_redo_same(q, args["quat"]):
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "source / normalized quat 不正确")
    return by, action


def verb_imu_recalibrate(op, args, raw):
    op.by, action = check_imu_redo_args(args)
    if action != "status" and op.ctx.env.get(DETACH_ENV) != "1":
        return detach(op, raw, "imu-recalibrate")
    op.take_lock("IMU 校准")
    m = imu_redo_load(op)
    if action == "status":
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "imu_status", "读到初次 IMU 校准会话", m or {"active": False, "phase": "idle"}, record=False)
    if flag_present(op.ctx):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bus_held", "舵机页占着总线：先交还主程序")
    if "profile" in args or (m and "profile" in m):
        op.service_lock_handle = op.ctx.lock(SERVICE_LOCK)
        if op.service_lock_handle is None:
            raise Stop(EXIT_BUSY, "busy", "主程序管理 / 更新正在进行：稍后再试")
    if action == "enter" and "profile" in args:
        return imu_profile_enter(op, args, m)
    if action == "enter":
        if (m and m["active"]) or exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_recalibrate_active", "初次 IMU 校准会话已经开着：继续或取消")
        if exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "出厂标定模式直接做粗校，无需重做会话")
        argv = imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op))
        if "--commissioning" in argv:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "foreign_commissioning", "主程序已经在外来的标定模式")
        bus = imu_redo_gate(op, "motion")
        data, _ = read_calibration(op)
        status, err = calibration_status(op)
        if status is None:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", f"原始标定读不回：{err}")
        source = imu_redo_source(bus, status)
        imu_redo_readback(op, data, source)
        # Save service states before stopping, and save every backup before touching ExecStart.
        controllers = {"padd": is_active(op, "padd"), "gamesir": is_active(op, GAMESIR)}
        ensure_dir(op.ctx, OPLOG_DIR, 0o755)
        ensure_dir(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DIR, 0o755)
        session = secrets.token_hex(16)
        directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + session
        ensure_dir(op.ctx, directory, 0o700)
        files = []
        for path, name in ((CALIB, "main.toml"), (CALIB_SAVED, "saved.toml")):
            meta, contents = file_meta(op.ctx, path)
            meta.update(path=path, name=name)
            if contents is not None:
                imu_redo_file(op, path)
                write_atomic(op.ctx, directory + "/" + name, contents, 0o600)
            files.append(meta)
        baseline = (json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
        write_atomic(op.ctx, directory + "/calibration.json", baseline, 0o600)
        m = {"schema": IMU_REDO_SCHEMA, "active": True, "session_id": session, "source": source,
             "exec_args": argv, "files": files, "controllers": controllers, "calibration_sha256": _sha256(baseline)}
        m["override_sha256"] = _sha256(imu_redo_override(m))
        imu_redo_save(op, m, "entering")
        override_written = False
        try:
            pads_stop(op)
            if is_active(op, "padd") or is_active(op, GAMESIR):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "手柄服务没停下，未切换模式")
            imu_redo_gate(op, "motion", source)
            if imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != argv or _sha256(imu_redo_file(op, CALIB)) != files[0]["sha256"]:
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "进入前主程序参数或标定文件已改变")
            write_atomic(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN, imu_redo_override(m), 0o644)
            override_written = True
            if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0:
                raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "模式配置没有重新加载")
            imu_redo_owned(op, m)
            imu_redo_restart(op, "commissioning", data, source)
            imu_redo_save(op, m, "commissioning")
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "imu_entered", "已进入初次 IMU 校准：保持失能，按原来的静止 / 前倾粗校再验证", m)
        except Exception as err:
            try:
                if override_written or exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN):
                    imu_redo_restore_original(op, m)
                else:
                    # A failed second gate has changed no robotd files or mode. Do not
                    # restart a robot whose torque state just became unsafe/unknown.
                    pads_restore(op, controllers)
                    imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelled", active=False)
            except Exception as rb:
                imu_redo_save(op, m, "recovery_required", reason=str(rb))
                return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "rollback_failed", f"进入没完成，恢复也没完成：{rb}；保留会话", m)
            if isinstance(err, Stop):
                return op.finish(err.code, err.result, err.reason, m)
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "enter_failed", f"进入失败，已恢复原来的文件和模式：{err}", m)
    if not m or not m["active"] or args["session_id"] != m["session_id"]:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "no_session", "这份初次 IMU 校准会话已改变或已结束")
    imu_redo_owned(op, m, allow_missing=(m["phase"] in ("entering", "finishing", "cancelling", "recovery_required")))
    # A reboot may have started pad services again while the persistent override
    # kept robotd in commissioning. Stop them again before returning to motion.
    if "profile" in m:
        imu_profile_controllers_stop(op)
    else:
        pads_stop(op)
    if is_active(op, "padd") or is_active(op, GAMESIR):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", "手柄服务没停下，会话保留")
    if action == "cancel":
        # Disk config, loaded ExecStart and the live process can differ after a
        # killed transition. Choose the safety gate from a fresh live snapshot;
        # imu_redo_owned independently checks the installed/effective command.
        live, err = robotd_bus_status(op)
        mode = (live or {}).get("mode")
        if mode not in ("motion", "commissioning"):
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "refused", f"取消前主程序的当前模式读不回：{err or mode}；会话保留")
        if "profile" in m:
            imu_profile_gate(op)
        else:
            imu_redo_gate(op, mode, m["source"])
        imu_redo_save(op, m, "cancelling")
        try:
            status = imu_redo_restore_original(op, m)
            note = ("已恢复原类型和 IMU 标定，保持标定模式；可重新选择并验证"
                    if m.get("original_mode") in ("startup", "commissioning") else
                    "已取消重做，恢复原来的 IMU 标定和运动模式，保持失能")
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "imu_cancelled", note, dict(m, calibration=status))
        except Exception as err:
            imu_redo_save(op, m, "recovery_required", reason=str(err))
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "cancel_failed", f"取消未完成，会话和备份仍在：{err}", m)
    source, quat = args["source"], args["quat"]
    if source != m["source"]:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_source_changed", "当前来源与进入会话时不同")
    imu_redo_gate(op, "commissioning", source)
    current = _load_toml(op, CALIB)
    if not imu_redo_same(normalized_calibration(current), normalized_calibration(_load_toml(op, CALIB_SAVED))):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "主标定与 saved 读回不一致")
    imu_redo_readback(op, current, source, quat)
    if "profile" in m:
        imu_profile_config(op, m["exec_args"])
        for row in m["config_files"]:
            if _sha256(imu_profile_safe_file(op, row["path"])) != row.get("selected_sha256"):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "已选类型的配置文件已改变，保留会话")
        imu_profile_readback(op, m["profile"], require_discovery=True)
    directory = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/" + m["session_id"]
    baseline = json.loads(imu_redo_file(op, directory + "/calibration.json"))
    import copy
    def without_allowed(cal):
        cal = copy.deepcopy(cal)
        cal.pop("motion_enabled", None)
        if source == "bus":
            cal.pop("imu_mount_quat", None)
            cal.pop("imu_mount_verified", None)
            cal.pop("imu_bus_protocol", None)
            cal.pop("imu_bus_profile", None)
        else:
            mount = (cal.get("imu_mounts") or {}).get(source)
            if isinstance(mount, dict):
                mount.pop("quat", None)
                mount.pop("verified", None)
        return normalized_calibration(cal)
    if not imu_redo_same(without_allowed(baseline), without_allowed(current)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "readback_mismatch", "除当前 IMU 方向和 motion_enabled 外，其他标定已改变：停止完成")
    before = {path: file_meta(op.ctx, path) for path in (CALIB, CALIB_SAVED)}
    text = before[CALIB][1].decode("utf-8")
    replacement = "motion_enabled = " + _bool_text(baseline.get("motion_enabled"))
    text, count = re.subn(r"(?m)^motion_enabled\s*=\s*(?:true|false)\s*(?:#[^\n]*)?$", replacement, text)
    if count != 1:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "motion_enabled 没有唯一的顶层写法，不猜测修改")
    expected = tomllib.loads(text)
    restored = copy.deepcopy(current)
    restored["motion_enabled"] = baseline["motion_enabled"]
    if not imu_redo_same(expected, restored):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "bad_toml", "恢复 motion_enabled 会改变其他字段，停止完成")
    imu_redo_save(op, m, "finishing", expected_quat=quat)
    try:
        for path in (CALIB, CALIB_SAVED):
            _write_preserving(op, path, text.encode(), before[path][0], 0o644)
            if not imu_redo_same(_load_toml(op, path), expected):
                raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "readback_mismatch", "安装后文件读回不一致")
        imu_redo_owned(op, m)
        remove(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN)
        target_args = m.get("original_args", m["exec_args"])
        if op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])[0] != 0 or imu_redo_arguments(exec_start(op)) != target_args:
            raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "restart_failed", "原来的启动参数没有恢复")
        target_mode = "commissioning" if m.get("original_mode") == "commissioning" else "motion"
        status = imu_redo_restart(op, target_mode, expected, source)
        imu_redo_readback(op, expected, source, quat)
        if "profile" in m:
            imu_profile_controllers_restore(op, m["controllers"])
        else:
            pads_restore(op, m["controllers"])
        imu_redo_save(op, m, "finished", active=False)
        note = ("IMU 方向已验证，类型已保存，继续出厂标定流程"
                if target_mode == "commissioning" else
                "初次 IMU 校准已重新验证，原有舵机标定保持，已回运动模式并失能")
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "imu_finished", note, dict(m, calibration=status))
    except Exception as err:
        # Keep the successfully verified commissioning state, never the original unverified candidate.
        try:
            for path, (meta, contents) in before.items():
                _write_preserving(op, path, contents, meta, 0o644)
            if exists(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN) and imu_redo_file(op, IMU_REDO_DROPIN) != imu_redo_override(m):
                raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "imu_session_tampered", "模式文件已改变，未覆盖")
            write_atomic(op.ctx, IMU_REDO_DROPIN, imu_redo_override(m), 0o644)
            op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])
            imu_redo_restart(op, "commissioning", current, source)
            imu_redo_save(op, m, "finish_failed", reason=str(err))
        except Exception as rb:
            imu_redo_save(op, m, "recovery_required", reason=str(rb))
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "finish_failed", f"完成没成功，已保留标定会话和验证后的方向，可重试或取消：{err}", m)

def verb_take(op, args):
    check_keys(args, ("by", "allow_seated"), "bus-take 的参数")
    op.by = check_by(args)
    allow_seated = args.get("allow_seated", False)
    if not isinstance(allow_seated, bool):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "allow_seated 要是 true / false")
    op.take_lock()
    imu_redo_conflict(op)
    guard_installed(op)
    session_open = flag_present(op.ctx)
    if session_open:
        op.emit("session", "info", "旗已经在（上次调舵机没退出）：核对主程序确实停着就行")
    started_hold = False
    if hold_active(op):
        op.emit("lock", "info", "管理锁已经在 Studio 手里")
    else:
        if not hold_start(op):
            raise Stop(EXIT_BUSY, "busy", "拿不到管理锁 /run/microduck-service-management.lock：板端脚本正在跑？等它跑完再试")
        started_hold = True
        op.emit("lock", "info", "管理锁拿到了（microduck-bus-hold）")
    pads = pads_stop(op)
    why = "主程序没在跑"
    if running(robotd_state(op)):
        try:
            why = gate(op, allow_seated)
        except Stop:
            pads_restore(op, pads)
            if started_hold and not session_open:
                hold_stop(op)
            raise
    op.emit("gate", "info", f"可以接管：{why}")
    flag_write(op, "bus-take")
    op.emit("flag", "info", "立旗：robotd 从现在起起不来（ConditionPathExists=!）")
    if not stop_robotd(op):
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "stop_failed", "主程序停不下来（KILL 以后也没停）。旗留着，别开串口",
                   {"flag": True, "lock": True})
    free, who = port_free(op)
    if free is not True:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "port_busy",
                   f"串口 {PORT} 还被占着（{who}）。旗留着；看是谁开着它" if free is False else f"查不了串口有没有人占：{who}",
                   {"flag": True, "lock": True})
    return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "taken", f"接管好了：{why}；主程序停着，Studio 可以开串口",
                     {"pads_were": pads, "session_was_open": session_open})


def check_give_args(args):
    check_keys(args, ("by", "soft", "marker"), "bus-give-back 的参数")
    by = check_by(args)
    soft = "soft" in args
    if soft == ("marker" in args):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "bus-give-back 要么 {soft: true}，要么 {marker: {...}}，二选一")
    if soft and args["soft"] is not True:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "soft 只能是 true")
    return by, soft


def verb_give_back(op, args, raw):
    op.by, soft = check_give_args(args)
    if not soft:
        build_marker(op, args["marker"], op.by)        # 先在这里校验一遍，参数错就不用转出去了
    if op.ctx.env.get(DETACH_ENV) != "1":
        return detach(op, raw)
    op.take_lock()
    if not flag_present(op.ctx) or not hold_active(op):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "no_session", "没有调舵机的会话（旗或管理锁不在）：总线现在不归 Studio，没东西可交还",
                   {"flag": flag_present(op.ctx), "lock": hold_active(op)})
    requested = parse_requested_ms(op)
    if abort_requested(op, requested, consume=False):
        remove(op.ctx, ABORT)
        raise Stop(EXIT_BUSY, "aborted", "交还还没开始就被中止了（页面按了卸力）", {"lock": True})
    stale = read_json(op.ctx, ABORT)
    if stale is not None or exists(op.ctx, ABORT):
        remove(op.ctx, ABORT)
        op.emit("abort", "info", "清掉以前留下的中止请求（比这次交还早）")
    return give_soft(op, requested) if soft else give_marker(op, args["marker"], requested)


def parse_requested_ms(op):
    v = op.ctx.env.get(REQUESTED_ENV, "")
    return int(v) if re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,15}", v or "") else int(op.ctx.now() * 1000)


def abort_requested(op, requested_ms, consume=True):
    a = read_json(op.ctx, ABORT)
    if a is None:
        return False
    m = a.get("mono_ms")
    if is_int(m) and m >= requested_ms:
        if consume:
            remove(op.ctx, ABORT)
        return True
    return False


def detach(op, raw, verb="bus-give-back"):
    """第一次被调用：用 systemd-run 把自己放进独立的临时单元再跑一遍，stdin 原样转过去，输出原样转回来。
    Studio 死了，这边的 systemd-run 跟着死，临时单元里那个照样跑完（它忽略 SIGPIPE，写不出去就只写 journal）。"""
    token = secrets.token_hex(8)
    stamp = f"{int(time.time())}-{op.ctx.pid()}"
    requested = int(op.ctx.now() * 1000)
    unit = ("microduck-calib-" if verb == "calib-commit" else "microduck-handover-") + stamp
    argv = ["systemd-run", "--wait", "--pipe", "--collect", "--quiet", f"--unit={unit}",
            f"--setenv={DETACH_ENV}=1", f"--setenv={REQUEST_ENV}={token}", f"--setenv={REQUESTED_ENV}={requested}",
            op.ctx.self_path, verb]
    rc = op.ctx.relay(argv, raw, op.write_out)
    last = read_json(op.ctx, LAST)
    if last and last.get("request_id") == token and is_int(last.get("exit")):
        return last["exit"]
    if rc in (EXIT_OK, EXIT_ARGS, EXIT_STATE, EXIT_BUSY, EXIT_FAIL, EXIT_RETAKE) and rc != EXIT_OK:
        return rc
    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "detach_failed",
                     f"独立单元没跑出结果（systemd-run 退出码 {rc}）：看 journalctl -t microduck-helper",
                     {"systemd_run_rc": rc, "unit": unit})


def startup_step4(op):
    try:
        rep = op.ctx.startup_report(1.0)
    except RpcError:
        return None
    steps = rep.get("steps") if isinstance(rep, dict) else None
    s4 = steps.get("4") if isinstance(steps, dict) else None
    return s4.get("status") if isinstance(s4, dict) else None


def bus_status(op):
    try:
        b = op.ctx.rpc("robot.busStatus", {}, 0.5)
        return b if isinstance(b, dict) else None
    except RpcError:
        return None


def robotd_up(bus):
    """主程序起来了吗：运动模式进了 control，或者标定模式回的是实时快照（read_error 也算：起来了，只是读舵机出错）。"""
    if not isinstance(bus, dict):
        return False
    mode, phase = bus.get("mode"), bus.get("phase")
    return (mode == "motion" and phase == "control") or (mode == "commissioning" and phase in COMMISSIONING_UP)


def still_starting_text(bus, waited):
    """等满了，主程序还在回话、但一直报启动阶段：照实说（Studio 总览「一直报启动中」同一个口气）。"""
    phase, err = bus.get("phase"), bus.get("error")
    if err:
        return f"主程序 {waited:.0f} 秒一直报「启动中」（{phase}：{err}）：去日志页看主程序最后说了什么"
    return f"主程序 {waited:.0f} 秒一直报「启动中」（phase={phase}）：{STILL_STARTING}"


def start_robotd(op):
    op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "reset-failed", "robotd"])
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "start", "--no-block", "robotd"])
    op.emit("start", "info", "起主程序（reset-failed 过；成没成看 ActiveState/ConditionResult，不看这个退出码）",
            {"rc": rc, "stderr": err.strip()[:200]})


def retake(op, reason, detail=None):
    """交接没成：重新立旗 → 停 robotd（不写扭矩）→ 删标记 → 锁一直在手里。Studio 重开串口接着保持。"""
    op.emit("retake", "warn", f"交接没成，把总线拿回来给 Studio：{reason}", detail)
    flag_write(op, "retake")
    ok = stop_robotd(op, "retake")
    if remove(op.ctx, MARKER):
        op.emit("retake", "info", "删掉没被读走的交接标记")
    free, who = port_free(op)
    d = dict(detail or {}, flag=True, lock=True, port_free=free)
    if not ok:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "retake_failed", f"{reason}；而且主程序停不下来：别开串口", d)
    if free is not True:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "retake_failed", f"{reason}；串口还被占着（{who}）", d)
    return op.finish(EXIT_RETAKE, "retake", reason, d)


def declined_reason(bus):
    ho = bus.get("handover") if isinstance(bus.get("handover"), dict) else {}
    detail = {k: ho.get(k) for k in ("reason", "joint", "item") if ho.get(k) is not None}
    if not detail and bus.get("error"):
        detail["reason"] = bus.get("error")
    parts = [f"#{detail['joint']}" if detail.get("joint") is not None else None, detail.get("item"), detail.get("reason")]
    text = "主程序核对交接标记没过：" + "，".join(str(p) for p in parts if p)
    return text, detail


def give_marker(op, given, requested):
    marker = build_marker(op, given, op.by)
    free, who = port_free(op)
    if free is not True:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "refused",
                   f"串口 {PORT} 还被占着（{who}）：Studio 关了串口没有？没交还，会话照旧" if free is False else f"查不了串口：{who}",
                   {"flag": True, "lock": True})
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, MARKER_DIR, 0o700)
    write_atomic(op.ctx, MARKER, (json.dumps(marker, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o600)
    op.emit("marker", "info", "交接标记写好了", {"ttl_ms": marker["ttl_ms"], "mono_ms": marker["mono_ms"]})
    remove(op.ctx, FLAG)
    op.emit("flag", "info", "撤旗（管理锁不放，等出结果）")
    start_robotd(op)
    t_start = op.ctx.now()
    seen_read = False
    last_phase = None
    while True:
        op.ctx.sleep(GIVE_POLL)
        elapsed = op.ctx.now() - t_start
        if abort_requested(op, requested):
            return op.finish(EXIT_BUSY, "aborted", "交还被中止（页面按了卸力）：bus-abort 在停主程序、把总线还给 Studio",
                             {"lock": True})
        st = robotd_state(op)
        marker_left = exists(op.ctx, MARKER)
        if not marker_left and not seen_read:
            seen_read = True
            op.emit("wait", "info", "主程序读走了交接标记")
        if stopped(st) and st.get("ConditionResult") == "no":
            return retake(op, "主程序被 Condition 挡住了，没起来（旗又出现了？）", st)
        if st.get("Result") == "start-limit-hit":
            return retake(op, "主程序撞上了启动次数限制（start-limit-hit）", st)
        bus = bus_status(op)
        if bus is not None:
            phase = bus.get("phase")
            if phase != last_phase:
                op.emit("wait", "info", f"主程序 phase={phase}")
                last_phase = phase
            ho = bus.get("handover") if isinstance(bus.get("handover"), dict) else {}
            if phase == "handover_declined" or ho.get("result") == "declined":
                text, detail = declined_reason(bus)
                return retake(op, text, detail)
            if bus.get("mode") == "commissioning" and robotd_up(bus):
                # 标定模式不认交接标记：开总线时先全部卸力（feetech_commissioning.rs 的 torque_off），没东西可拿回。
                # 起来了就别等 15 秒再把总线拿回来
                remove(op.ctx, MARKER)
                pads_start(op)
                hold_stop(op)
                return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "limp", "主程序起来了，在标定模式：标定模式不接手保持，起来时已经全部卸力",
                                 {"mode": "commissioning", "phase": phase})
            if phase == "control":
                s4 = startup_step4(op)
                if s4 == "success":
                    if ho.get("result") == "adopted":
                        remove(op.ctx, ABORT)
                        pads_start(op)
                        hold_stop(op)
                        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "adopted", "主程序接手保持了：15 颗上着力，没开模型；点「站起来」才回站姿",
                                         {"handover": ho, "ms_to_adopt": int(elapsed * 1000)})
                    # 进了控制循环却没接手：robotd 没认标记（版本旧 / 开关没开），或者接手以后崩溃重启过。
                    # 这两种舵机都已经照老规矩全卸了，没东西可拿回
                    remove(op.ctx, MARKER)
                    pads_start(op)
                    hold_stop(op)
                    why = ("主程序没认交接标记（版本旧，或者 drop-in 里的开关没开）" if marker_left
                           else "主程序没接手（可能接手以后重启过）")
                    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "limp", f"{why}：已经照老规矩全部卸力", {"handover": ho or None})
        if marker_left and elapsed >= MARKER_READ_TIMEOUT:
            return retake(op, f"{MARKER_READ_TIMEOUT:.0f} 秒没读交接标记（主程序没起来，或者卡在标定 / 参数文件检查）",
                          {"robotd": st, "phase": last_phase})
        if elapsed >= ADOPT_TIMEOUT:
            return retake(op, f"{ADOPT_TIMEOUT:.0f} 秒还没走完启动第 4 步（多半卡在等 IMU）",
                          {"robotd": st, "phase": last_phase})


def give_soft(op, requested):
    free, who = port_free(op)
    if free is not True:
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "refused",
                   f"串口 {PORT} 还被占着（{who}）：Studio 关了串口没有？" if free is False else f"查不了串口：{who}",
                   {"flag": True, "lock": True})
    if remove(op.ctx, MARKER):
        op.emit("marker", "info", "删掉以前留下的交接标记（软交还不要它）")
    remove(op.ctx, FLAG)
    op.emit("flag", "info", "撤旗")
    start_robotd(op)
    t_start = op.ctx.now()
    last_bus = None
    while True:
        op.ctx.sleep(GIVE_POLL)
        if abort_requested(op, requested):
            return op.finish(EXIT_BUSY, "aborted", "交还被中止（页面按了卸力）", {"lock": True})
        st = robotd_state(op)
        if stopped(st) and st.get("ConditionResult") == "no":
            hold_stop(op)
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "soft_failed", "主程序被 Condition 挡住了，没起来（旗又出现了？）", st)
        bus = bus_status(op)
        if bus is not None:
            last_bus = bus
        # 起来了 = 运动模式 control，或者标定模式的实时快照（ready / moving / read_error / stop_unconfirmed / power_pending）
        if robotd_up(bus) and startup_step4(op) == "success":
            pads_start(op)
            hold_stop(op)
            if bus.get("mode") == "commissioning":
                err = bus.get("last_cycle_error") if bus.get("phase") == "read_error" else None
                return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "soft", "交还好了：主程序起来了，在标定模式（照老规矩全卸着）"
                                 + (f"；但读舵机出错：{err}" if err else ""),
                                 {"mode": "commissioning", "phase": bus.get("phase")})
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "soft", "交还好了：主程序起来了（照老规矩全卸着）")
        if op.ctx.now() - t_start >= SOFT_TIMEOUT:
            pads_start(op)
            hold_stop(op)
            if isinstance(last_bus, dict) and last_bus.get("phase") in STARTING_PHASES:
                # 主程序在回话，只是一直报启动阶段（旧 fork 的标定模式永远报 configuring_bus）：照旧判没起来，话照实说。
                # msg 也放进 detail：Studio 只读 done 那一行的 detail，靠它把整句给页面（不说成「起不来」）
                text = still_starting_text(last_bus, SOFT_TIMEOUT)
                return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "soft_failed", text,
                                 dict(st, phase=last_bus.get("phase"), mode=last_bus.get("mode"), still_starting=True, msg=text))
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "soft_failed",
                             f"主程序 {SOFT_TIMEOUT:.0f} 秒没走完启动（舵机已经卸着了，不用拿回）：看 robotd 日志", st)


def require_robotctl(op):
    if not os.path.isfile(op.ctx.p(ROBOTCTL)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "no_robotctl", f"找不到官方 robotctl：{ROBOTCTL}", {"path": ROBOTCTL})


def verb_pad_pair(op, args):
    """官方 robotctl pad pair --json：停 btd / 重开蓝牙都在 robotctl 里。这里只跑命令、读结果。
    不碰总线旗子、hold 单元、robotd，也不拿服务管理锁；只用 helper.lock 防止两个配对同时跑。"""
    op.by, mac, timeout = check_pad_pair_args(args)
    op.take_lock("手柄操作")
    require_robotctl(op)
    limit = timeout + PAD_EXTRA_S
    argv = [ROBOTCTL, "pad", "pair", "--json", "--timeout", str(timeout)]
    if mac:
        argv.append(mac)
    op.emit("pad-pair", "info", f"跑官方 robotctl pad pair（最多 {limit} 秒）",
            {"argv": argv[1:], "by": op.by})
    rc, out, err, timed_out = op.ctx.run_robotctl(argv, limit)
    stderr = _stderr_lines(err)
    if timed_out:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "timeout", f"robotctl pad pair 超过 {limit} 秒，已经杀掉",
                         {"stderr": stderr, "stdout": out[-2000:], "rc": None})
    try:
        pair = json.loads((out or "").strip())
    except ValueError:
        pair = None
    if not isinstance(pair, dict) or pair.get("outcome") not in ("paired", "failed"):
        why = (err or out or "").strip()[:600] or f"robotctl 退出码 {rc}"
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "bad_output", f"robotctl 的回包看不懂：{why}",
                         {"stderr": stderr, "stdout": out[-2000:], "rc": rc})
    detail = {"pair": pair, "stderr": stderr, "stdout": out.strip()[:4000], "rc": rc}
    if pair.get("outcome") == "paired":
        pad = pair.get("pad") if isinstance(pair.get("pad"), dict) else {}
        who = pad.get("name") or pad.get("mac") or "手柄"
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "paired", f"配上了：{who}", detail)
    reason = pair.get("reason") or "other"
    detail["reason"] = reason
    text = f"robotctl 说配对失败：{reason}"
    if pair.get("detail"):
        text += f"（{pair['detail']}）"
    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "pair_failed", text, detail)


def verb_pad_forget(op, args):
    op.by, mac = check_pad_forget_args(args)
    op.take_lock("手柄操作")
    require_robotctl(op)
    argv = [ROBOTCTL, "pad", "forget", mac]
    op.emit("pad-forget", "info", f"跑官方 robotctl pad forget {mac}", {"argv": argv[1:], "by": op.by})
    rc, out, err, timed_out = op.ctx.run_robotctl(argv, FORGET_TIMEOUT_S)
    stderr = _stderr_lines(err)
    detail = {"stdout": out.strip()[:4000], "stderr": stderr, "rc": rc}
    if timed_out:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "timeout", f"robotctl pad forget 超过 {FORGET_TIMEOUT_S} 秒，已经杀掉", detail)
    if re.search(rf"^forgot\s+{re.escape(mac)}\b", out or "", re.M | re.I):
        removed = True
    elif re.search(rf"{re.escape(mac)}\s+was not paired", out or "", re.I):
        removed = False
    else:
        removed = None
    detail["removed"] = removed
    if rc != 0:
        why = (err or out or "").strip()[:600] or f"robotctl 退出码 {rc}"
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "forget_failed", f"robotctl pad forget 没成功：{why}", detail)
    return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "forgotten",
                     f"忘掉了 {mac}" if removed is not False else f"{mac} 本来就没配对", detail)


def verb_abort(op, args):
    """中止交接。不拿 helper.lock：不能被正在跑的 bus-give-back 挡住。几步都可以重复做。"""
    check_keys(args, ("by",), "bus-abort 的参数")
    op.by = check_by(args)
    if not (flag_present(op.ctx) or hold_active(op) or exists(op.ctx, MARKER)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "no_session",
                   "没有调舵机的会话（旗、管理锁、交接标记都不在）：不中止，不碰主程序")
    if not flag_present(op.ctx):
        flag_write(op, "bus-abort")
        op.emit("flag", "info", "立旗")
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, HELPER_DIR, 0o755)
    write_atomic(op.ctx, ABORT, (json.dumps({"by": op.by, "mono_ms": int(op.ctx.now() * 1000)}) + "\n").encode(), 0o644)
    killed = False
    if running(robotd_state(op)):
        op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "kill", "-s", "KILL", "robotd"])
        killed = True
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + ABORT_KILL_WAIT
    st = robotd_state(op)
    while running(st) and op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        op.ctx.sleep(ABORT_POLL)
        st = robotd_state(op)
    removed = remove(op.ctx, MARKER)
    free, who = port_free(op)
    while free is False and op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        op.ctx.sleep(ABORT_POLL)
        free, who = port_free(op)
    hold = hold_active(op)
    if not hold:
        hold = hold_start(op)
    detail = {"killed": killed, "marker_removed": removed, "lock": hold, "robotd": st}
    if running(st):
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "abort_incomplete", "主程序 KILL 以后还没停：别开串口，关电源最保险", detail)
    if free is not True:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "abort_incomplete", f"串口还被占着（{who}）", detail)
    reason = "中止了：主程序停着，Studio 可以开串口卸力"
    if not hold:
        reason += "（管理锁没拿到：板端脚本可能在跑，主程序照样被旗挡着）"
    return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "aborted", reason, detail)


# WiFi 热点：配网时 Studio 先关热点、再让 configd 连家里的 WiFi

def _nmcli_unescape(s):
    """nmcli -t 把冒号、反斜杠转义了（SSID 里可能真有冒号）；连接名是我们自己的，还是按规矩解一下。"""
    return (s or "").replace("\\:", ":").replace("\\\\", "\\")


def wifi_active(op):
    """wlan0 上现在挂着 Microduck-Hotspot 吗：是就回设备名，不是回 None。
    查不了（nmcli 不在 / 报错）抛 Stop，让调用方写清卡在哪一步。"""
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["nmcli", "-t", "-f", "NAME,DEVICE", "connection", "show", "--active"])
    if rc != 0:
        why = (err or out).strip()[:300] or f"nmcli 退出码 {rc}"
        raise Stop(EXIT_FAIL, "nmcli_failed", f"查不了现在的网络连接：{why}", {"rc": rc})
    for line in (out or "").splitlines():
        name, sep, dev = line.partition(":")
        if sep and _nmcli_unescape(name) == HOTSPOT:
            return _nmcli_unescape(dev) or "?"
    return None


def check_wifi_args(args, verb):
    check_keys(args, ("by", "ssid") if verb == "wifi-hotspot-down" else ("by",), f"{verb} 的参数")
    by = check_by(args)
    ssid = args.get("ssid")
    if ssid is not None:
        if not isinstance(ssid, str) or len(ssid.encode("utf-8")) > 32 or "\x00" in ssid:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "ssid 要是 0–32 字节的字符串")
    return by, ssid


def write_studio_connecting(op, ssid):
    """关热点前写下 netcheck 的约定文件：until 以前它不插手，Studio 才能安心让 configd 连。"""
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, STUDIO_CONNECTING_DIR, 0o755)
    payload = {"until": int(time.time()) + STUDIO_CONNECTING_S, "ssid": ssid or ""}
    write_atomic(op.ctx, STUDIO_CONNECTING,
                 (json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
    op.emit("connecting-window", "info", f"写下连接窗口（{STUDIO_CONNECTING_S} 秒，SSID：{ssid or '未写'}）")


def clear_studio_connecting(op):
    try:
        if remove(op.ctx, STUDIO_CONNECTING):
            op.emit("connecting-window", "info", "删掉连接窗口文件")
    except OSError as e:
        op.emit("connecting-window", "warn", f"删连接窗口文件没成功：{type(e).__name__}: {e}")


def verb_wifi_hotspot_down(op, args):
    """关热点。热点本来就没开算成功（nmcli 的「不是活动连接」也当成功）。最多等 10 秒，等 wlan0 不再是这个连接。"""
    op.by, ssid = check_wifi_args(args, "wifi-hotspot-down")
    op.take_lock("WiFi 操作", WIFI_LOCK)
    active = wifi_active(op)
    if active is None:
        op.emit("hotspot", "info", "热点本来就没开")
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "already_down", "热点本来就没开", {"device": None})
    op.emit("hotspot", "info", f"关热点：{active} 上挂着 {HOTSPOT}", {"device": active})
    try:
        write_studio_connecting(op, ssid)
    except (OSError, Stop) as e:
        why = e.reason if isinstance(e, Stop) else f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "window_failed", f"连接窗口文件写不进去：{why}", {"path": STUDIO_CONNECTING})
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["nmcli", "connection", "down", HOTSPOT], timeout=NMCLI_DOWN_TIMEOUT)
    msg = (err or out).strip()[:300]
    if rc != 0:
        if re.search(r"not an active connection|not active|no active connection", msg, re.I):
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "already_down", "热点本来就关了", {"rc": rc, "stderr": msg})
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "down_failed", f"nmcli 关热点没成功：{msg or f'退出码 {rc}'}",
                         {"rc": rc, "stderr": msg})
    deadline = op.ctx.now() + WIFI_DOWN_WAIT
    while op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        if wifi_active(op) is None:
            op.emit("hotspot", "info", "热点关了（wlan0 不再是 Microduck-Hotspot）")
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "hotspot_down", "热点关了", {"device": active})
        op.ctx.sleep(WIFI_POLL)
    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "timeout", f"关了 {WIFI_DOWN_WAIT:.0f} 秒，wlan0 还挂着 {HOTSPOT}",
                     {"device": active})


def verb_wifi_hotspot_up(op, args):
    """开热点。本来就开着算成功。从 nmcli up 开始算，最多等 30 秒到 wlan0 真的挂上这个连接。"""
    op.by, _ = check_wifi_args(args, "wifi-hotspot-up")
    op.take_lock("WiFi 操作", WIFI_LOCK)
    active = wifi_active(op)
    if active is not None:
        op.emit("hotspot", "info", f"热点本来就开着（{active}）")
        clear_studio_connecting(op)
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "already_up", "热点本来就开着", {"device": active})
    op.emit("hotspot", "info", f"开热点：nmcli connection up {HOTSPOT}")
    started = op.ctx.now()
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["nmcli", "connection", "up", HOTSPOT], timeout=WIFI_UP_WAIT)
    msg = (err or out).strip()[:300]
    if rc != 0:
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "up_failed", f"nmcli 开热点没成功：{msg or f'退出码 {rc}'}",
                         {"rc": rc, "stderr": msg})
    clear_studio_connecting(op)
    deadline = started + WIFI_UP_WAIT
    while op.ctx.now() < deadline:
        dev = wifi_active(op)
        if dev is not None:
            op.emit("hotspot", "info", f"热点开了（{dev}）")
            return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "hotspot_up", "热点开了", {"device": dev})
        op.ctx.sleep(WIFI_POLL)
    return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "timeout", f"开了 {WIFI_UP_WAIT:.0f} 秒，wlan0 还没挂上 {HOTSPOT}",
                     {"rc": rc, "stderr": msg})

# SSH 密码登录开关（Studio「更多」页）。镜像出厂只认钥匙、不带任何人的钥匙；用户在网页上自己定一个密码再打开，
# 没有人人都知道的默认密码（热点密码是公开的，默认密码等于给附近的人留门）。

def ssh_password_on(ctx):
    return os.path.isfile(ctx.p(SSH_PASSWORD_CONF))


def ssh_key_count(ctx):
    try:
        with open(ctx.p(SSH_KEYS), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            return sum(1 for line in f if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"))
    except OSError:
        return 0


def ssh_effective_password(op):
    """sshd -T 读回实际生效的 passwordauthentication：True / False / None（读不出）。"""
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["sshd", "-T"], timeout=10.0)
    if rc != 0:
        return None
    for line in (out or "").splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].lower() == "passwordauthentication":
            return parts[1].lower() == "yes"
    return None


def verb_ssh_status(op, args):
    check_keys(args, ("by",), "ssh-status 的参数")
    if "by" in args:
        op.by = check_by(args)
    rc, out, _ = op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "is-active", "ssh"], timeout=5.0)
    detail = {"password_login": ssh_password_on(op.ctx), "ssh_active": (out or "").strip() == "active",
              "keys": ssh_key_count(op.ctx), "user": SSH_USER}
    return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "ssh_status", "读到了 SSH 的状态", detail, record=False)


def check_ssh_password(pw):
    if not isinstance(pw, str):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "password 要是字符串")
    if not SSH_PW_MIN <= len(pw) <= SSH_PW_MAX:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_password", f"SSH 密码要 {SSH_PW_MIN}–{SSH_PW_MAX} 位")
    if any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in pw):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_password", "SSH 密码里不能有换行、制表这类控制字符")
    if pw.strip().lower() in SSH_PW_BANNED:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_password", "这个密码大家都猜得到，换一个")
    return pw


def ssh_reload(op):
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["systemctl", "reload-or-restart", "ssh"], timeout=20.0)
    if rc != 0:
        return (err or out or "").strip()[:400] or f"systemctl 退出码 {rc}"
    return None


def verb_ssh_password(op, args):
    check_keys(args, ("by", "on", "password"), "ssh-password 的参数")
    op.by = check_by(args)
    on = args.get("on")
    if not isinstance(on, bool):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "on 要是 true（打开）或 false（关掉）")
    if not on and "password" in args:
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "关掉 SSH 密码登录不用传密码")
    pw = check_ssh_password(args.get("password")) if on else None
    op.take_lock("SSH 设置", SSH_LOCK)
    conf = op.ctx.p(SSH_PASSWORD_CONF)
    if not on:
        existed = os.path.isfile(conf)
        if existed:
            os.remove(conf)
            op.emit("ssh", "info", "删掉了 SSH 密码登录的开关文件", {"path": SSH_PASSWORD_CONF})
        why = ssh_reload(op)
        if why:
            return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "reload_failed", f"开关文件删了，但 ssh 没重新加载：{why}（重启鸭子也会生效）",
                             {"password_login": False})
        return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "ssh_password_off", "SSH 密码登录关掉了，只认钥匙" if existed else "SSH 密码登录本来就是关着的",
                         {"password_login": False, "keys": ssh_key_count(op.ctx)})
    # 1. 密码：chpasswd 从 stdin 读「用户:密码」，不进命令行（ps 看得到命令行）、不进日志
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["chpasswd"], input=f"{SSH_USER}:{pw}\n".encode("utf-8"), timeout=15.0)
    if rc != 0:
        why = (err or out or "").strip()[:300] or f"退出码 {rc}"
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "chpasswd_failed", f"{SSH_USER} 的密码没设上：{why}")
    op.emit("ssh", "info", f"{SSH_USER} 的密码设好了（密码本身不记）")
    # 2. 开关文件
    ensure_dir(op.ctx, "/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d", 0o755)
    body = ("# Microduck Studio「更多」页打开的 SSH 密码登录（microduck-helper ssh-password）。\n"
            "# 关掉：Studio 里点「关掉 SSH 密码登录」，或者删掉这个文件再 systemctl reload ssh。\n"
            "PasswordAuthentication yes\n")
    write_atomic(op.ctx, SSH_PASSWORD_CONF, body.encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
    # 3. 先验配置再生效：语法不对、或者别的配置把密码登录压住了，都退回去
    rc, out, err = op.ctx.run(["sshd", "-t"], timeout=10.0)
    if rc != 0:
        os.remove(conf)
        why = (err or out or "").strip()[:400] or f"退出码 {rc}"
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "sshd_config_bad", f"sshd 配置检查没过，已经退回去：{why}")
    eff = ssh_effective_password(op)
    if eff is not True:
        os.remove(conf)
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "not_effective",
                         "sshd 读回来密码登录还是关着（别的配置压住了它），已经退回去" if eff is False
                         else "读不出 sshd 实际生效的配置，已经退回去", {"effective": eff})
    why = ssh_reload(op)
    if why:
        os.remove(conf)
        ssh_reload(op)
        return op.finish(EXIT_FAIL, "reload_failed", f"ssh 没重新加载，已经退回去：{why}")
    return op.finish(EXIT_OK, "ssh_password_on", f"SSH 密码登录打开了：用户 {SSH_USER}，密码是你刚设的",
                     {"password_login": True, "user": SSH_USER})

def load_native_update(op):
    """Compile already verified bytes from this installed signed release only.

    current is the sole permitted symlink. Every resolved parent, the suite,
    helper, module and optional native pair must be root owned and immutable to
    unprivileged users. Never import from sys.path or re-resolve current later.
    """
    import hashlib
    ctx = op.ctx
    root = "/opt/microduck/software"

    def read(path, limit):
        parts = path.strip('/').split('/')
        for i in range(1, len(parts)+1):
            st = os.lstat(ctx.p('/'+'/'.join(parts[:i])))
            if ((i<len(parts) and not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
                    or (i==len(parts) and not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode))
                    or (ctx.check_owner and (st.st_uid!=0 or st.st_mode & 0o022))):
                raise ValueError('unsafe release path')
        if st.st_size>limit: raise ValueError('release file exceeds bound')
        with open(ctx.p(path),'rb') as stream: return stream.read(limit+1)

    try:
        current = os.path.realpath(ctx.p(root+'/current'))
        releases = os.path.abspath(ctx.p(root+'/releases'))
        version = os.path.basename(current)
        if (not os.path.islink(ctx.p(root+'/current')) or os.path.dirname(current)!=releases
                or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(?:[-+][A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?',version)
                or os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(__file__))!=os.path.normcase(os.path.join(current,'studio','deploy','microduck-helper'))):
            raise ValueError('helper is not the current managed release')
        release = root+'/releases/'+version
        suite = json.loads(read(release+'/suite-version.json',4*1024*1024))
        if suite.get('version')!=version or not isinstance(suite.get('files'),dict): raise ValueError('invalid suite provenance')
        names = ['studio/deploy/microduck-helper','studio/deploy/native_update.py']
        native = ['studio/deploy/native/robotd','studio/deploy/native/manifest.json']
        companion = ['studio/deploy/native/padd','studio/deploy/native/controller-manifest.json']
        has_companion=any(os.path.lexists(ctx.p(release+'/'+name)) or name in suite['files'] for name in companion)
        controller='studio/deploy/controller_bundle.py'
        controller_state=any(os.path.lexists(ctx.p('/var/lib/microduck-helper/controller-update/'+n)) for n in ('journal.json','prepared.json'))
        if has_companion or controller in suite['files'] or controller_state:
            names.append(controller)
        if has_companion:
            contract=(suite.get('contracts') or {}).get('padd_mapping')
            if type(contract) is not int or contract!=1:raise ValueError('voice mapping contract missing')
            names+=companion+['duck-echo/duck_echo.py','duck-echo/pad_mapping.py']
        if has_companion or any(os.path.lexists(ctx.p(release+'/'+name)) or name in suite['files'] for name in native): names += native
        verified = {}
        for name in names:
            data = read(release+'/'+name,32*1024*1024)
            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=suite['files'].get(name): raise ValueError('signed suite hash mismatch')
            verified[name] = data
        namespace = {'__name__':'microduck_trusted_native_update','__file__':ctx.p(release+'/studio/deploy/native_update.py')}
        exec(compile(verified['studio/deploy/native_update.py'],namespace['__file__'],'exec'),namespace)
        if controller in verified:
            dependency={'__name__':'microduck_trusted_controller_bundle','__file__':ctx.p(release+'/'+controller)}
            exec(compile(verified[controller],dependency['__file__'],'exec'),dependency)
            namespace['CONTROLLER_BUNDLE']=types.SimpleNamespace(**dependency)
        return types.SimpleNamespace(**namespace), release
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,AttributeError) as error:
        raise Stop(EXIT_STATE,'native_untrusted_release','主程序更新只能从已安装并校验的 root 管理签名软件包运行') from error


def verb_robotd_update(op, args, raw):
    if (set(args)-{'by','action','confirmed'} or args.get('by')!='Studio'
            or args.get('action') not in ('status','install','recover','restore')
            or (args['action']!='status' and args.get('confirmed') is not True)
            or ('confirmed' in args and type(args['confirmed']) is not bool)):
        raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS,'bad_args','robotd-update 只接受 Studio 的固定动作和明确确认')
    module, release = load_native_update(op)
    if args['action']!='status' and op.ctx.env.get(DETACH_ENV)!='1':
        return detach(op, raw, 'robotd-update')
    return module.handle(types.SimpleNamespace(**globals()),op,args,release)


def native_update_conflict(op):
    """Other helper control verbs also respect interrupted native updates."""
    directory = OPLOG_DIR + '/native-update'
    path = directory + '/journal.json'
    exclusions = [directory+'/active',HELPER_DIR+'/native-update-restore',
                  '/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzzzzz-microduck-native-update.conf']
    exclusions += ['/etc/systemd/system/'+u+'.service.d/zzzzzzz-microduck-native-update.conf'
                   for u in ('padd',GAMESIR,'duck-echo')]
    active = any(exists(op.ctx,path) for path in exclusions)
    if not active and exists(op.ctx,path):
        try:
            if os.lstat(op.ctx.p(path)).st_size>65536:raise ValueError('oversized native state')
            m=json.loads(imu_profile_safe_file(op,path))
            if (m.get('schema')!='microduck-native-update/1' or type(m.get('active')) is not bool
                    or type(m.get('restore_pending',False)) is not bool
                    or type(m.get('cleanup_pending',False)) is not bool):raise ValueError('invalid native state')
            active=m['active'] or m.get('restore_pending',False) or m.get('cleanup_pending',False)
        except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,Stop):active=True
    for bundle in ('/var/lib/microduck-helper/controller-update/journal.json','/var/lib/microduck-helper/controller-update/prepared.json'):
        if not exists(op.ctx,bundle):continue
        try:
            if os.lstat(op.ctx.p(bundle)).st_size>65536:raise ValueError('oversized controller state')
            m=json.loads(imu_profile_safe_file(op,bundle))
            if (m.get('schema')!='microduck-controller-update/1' or type(m.get('active')) is not bool
                    or type(m.get('restore_pending')) is not bool or type(m.get('cleanup_pending')) is not bool):raise ValueError('invalid controller state')
            active=active or m['active'] or m['restore_pending'] or m['cleanup_pending']
        except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,Stop):active=True
    if active:raise Stop(EXIT_STATE,'native_update_active','主程序更新尚未完成：先完成或恢复更新，再操作总线 / 标定')


def run(argv, ctx):
    verb = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else None
    op = Op(ctx, verb or "?")
    try:
        if verb not in VERBS or len(argv) != 2:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_verb", f"只认这几个动词：{', '.join(VERBS)}（参数走 stdin 的 JSON）")
        if not ctx.is_root():
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "not_root", "要用 root 跑（sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/microduck-helper …）")
        raw = ctx.stdin.read(STDIN_LIMIT + 1)
        if len(raw) > STDIN_LIMIT:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "stdin 太长")
        try:
            args = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
        except ValueError as e:
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", f"stdin 不是 JSON：{e}") from e
        if not isinstance(args, dict):
            raise Stop(EXIT_ARGS, "bad_args", "stdin 要是一个 JSON 对象")
        if verb in ('bus-take','bus-give-back','calib-commit') or (verb=='imu-recalibrate' and args.get('action')!='status'):
            native_update_conflict(op)
        if verb == "bus-take":
            return verb_take(op, args)
        if verb == "bus-give-back":
            return verb_give_back(op, args, raw)
        if verb == "pad-pair":
            return verb_pad_pair(op, args)
        if verb == "pad-forget":
            return verb_pad_forget(op, args)
        if verb == "wifi-hotspot-down":
            return verb_wifi_hotspot_down(op, args)
        if verb == "wifi-hotspot-up":
            return verb_wifi_hotspot_up(op, args)
        if verb == "calib-read":
            return verb_calib_read(op, args)
        if verb == "calib-commit":
            return verb_calib_commit(op, args, raw)
        if verb == "imu-recalibrate":
            return verb_imu_recalibrate(op, args, raw)
        if verb == "robotd-update":
            return verb_robotd_update(op, args, raw)
        if verb == "ssh-status":
            return verb_ssh_status(op, args)
        if verb == "ssh-password":
            return verb_ssh_password(op, args)
        return verb_abort(op, args)
    except Stop as s:
        # bad_verb 是 Studio 探测小助手可用性用的：不能把上一次真正的结果覆盖成 bad_verb
        return op.finish(s.code, s.result, s.reason, s.detail, record=(s.result != "bad_verb"))
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 —— 小助手自己的 bug：也要留下结果
